### Add custom audience member
PUT /ad-publishing/facebook/custom-audience/{customAudienceId}/member
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/ad-publishing/facebook/custom-audience/{customAudienceId}/member
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/ad-publishing/fb-add-custom-audience-member | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/ad-publishing/fb-add-custom-audience-member.md

Add a single contact to a Facebook custom audience. The contact is resolved from `contactId` and its identifiers are hashed before being sent to Meta. Use the batch endpoint for more than one member.

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: adPublishing.write

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Path parameters:
- customAudienceId* string (e.g. "23851234567890123") - Custom audience identifier

Request body (required) (application/json) UpdateCustomAudienceDTO:
- locationId* string (e.g. "loc_abc123") - Location identifier
- contactId* string (e.g. "contact_123") - Contact identifier
- fbAdAccountId string (e.g. "act_123456") - Facebook ad account ID

Response 200 (Acknowledgement that the contact was added, naming the audience in `msg`) application/json:
- status* number - Always 200. Mirrors the HTTP status rather than reporting anything additional.
- msg* string - Human-readable confirmation. Wording varies with the operation performed.

Errors: 400, 401, 422, 500 (400, 401, 422, 500: see Common error responses)

### Batch update audience members
PUT /ad-publishing/facebook/custom-audience/{customAudienceId}/member/batch
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/ad-publishing/facebook/custom-audience/{customAudienceId}/member/batch
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/ad-publishing/fb-batch-update-audience-members | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/ad-publishing/fb-batch-update-audience-members.md

Add or remove members in bulk from a Facebook custom audience, sourced from a CSV or one or more smart lists — at least one of `csvPath` or `smartlistIds` is required. The work is queued rather than performed inline, so the acknowledgement confirms only that the job was accepted; nothing about the outcome is reported here. Unlike the single-member endpoints this one answers with `{ success: true }` rather than a status-and-message body.

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: adPublishing.write

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Path parameters:
- customAudienceId* string (e.g. "23851234567890123") - Custom audience identifier

Request body (required) (application/json) UpdateCustomAudienceBatchDTO:
- locationId* string (e.g. "loc_abc123") - Location identifier
- csvPath string (e.g. "/uploads/audience.csv") - CSV file path
- operationType* string (enum: ADD | REMOVE | REPLACE; e.g. "ADD") - Batch operation type
- smartlistIds string[] (e.g. ["list_1","list_2"]) - Smartlist IDs array
- dynamicAudience string (e.g. "true") - Dynamic audience flag

Response 200 (Acknowledgement that the bulk update was queued) application/json:
- success* boolean - True when the operation succeeded

Errors: 400, 401, 422, 500 (400, 401, 422, 500: see Common error responses)

### Create conversation form
POST /ad-publishing/facebook/conversation-forms
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/ad-publishing/facebook/conversation-forms
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/ad-publishing/fb-create-conversation-form | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/ad-publishing/fb-create-conversation-form.md

Create a Messenger conversation form. Note the created record is returned in its raw stored form rather than the shape the listing endpoint uses: the identifier comes back as `_id` instead of `id`, and the internal `__v` version key is included.

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: adPublishing.write

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Request body (required) (application/json) CreateConversationFormDTO:
- locationId* string (e.g. "loc_abc123") - Location identifier
- name* string (e.g. "Welcome Form") - Conversation form name
- text* string (e.g. "Hi! How can we help?") - Welcome message text
- questions* object[] - Quick-reply questions shown in the welcome message of the conversation form
  - question* string (e.g. "How can we help?") - Question title text
  - response string (e.g. "Thanks for reaching out") - Auto-response message

Response 201 (The stored conversation form) application/json:
- _id* string - Conversation form id. Note `_id`, not the `id` the listing endpoint returns for the same record.
- name* string - Form name
- text* string - Opening message
- locationId* string - Owning location
- questions* object[] - Prompt and canned-reply pairs as stored
  - question* string - Prompt offered to the user as a tappable reply
  - response string - Canned answer sent when the prompt is chosen. Omitted entirely on some records and an empty string on others, so treat missing and blank as the same thing.
  - _id string - Mongo subdocument id. Internal — do not depend on it.
- createdAt* string - Creation time, ISO-8601
- updatedAt* string - Last modification time, ISO-8601
- __v number - Mongo document version key, leaked by this branch only. Not part of the contract.

Errors: 400, 401, 422, 500 (400, 401, 422, 500: see Common error responses)

### Create page lead form
POST /ad-publishing/facebook/page/{pageId}/forms
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/ad-publishing/facebook/page/{pageId}/forms
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/ad-publishing/fb-create-page-lead-form | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/ad-publishing/fb-create-page-lead-form.md

Create a lead gen form. With `isDraft: true` the form is stored locally and returned as a draft; without it the form is published to Facebook and the Meta record is returned. The two responses share almost no fields. Publishing enforces at least one question and a complete `thankYouPage` (title, body, buttonText) where a draft save enforces neither. Pass `draftFormId` when publishing an existing draft to have it deleted afterwards — either the bare id or the `draft_`-prefixed form is accepted, and cleanup failures are logged rather than surfaced.

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: adPublishing.write

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Path parameters:
- pageId* string (e.g. "103456789012345") - Facebook page identifier

Request body (required) (application/json) CreateLeadFormDTO:
- type* string (enum: MORE_VOLUME | HIGHER_INTENT; e.g. "MORE_VOLUME") - Lead form type
- name* string (e.g. "Contact Form") - Lead form name
- locationId* string (e.g. "loc_abc123") - Location identifier
- greetingCard object - Greeting card config
  - title* string (e.g. "Welcome!") - Greeting card title
  - style* string (enum: LIST_STYLE | PARAGRAPH_STYLE; e.g. "LIST_STYLE") - Greeting card style
  - content* string[] (e.g. ["Learn more about our services"]) - Greeting card content
- questions* object[] - List of questions displayed on the lead form. Required (non-empty) when `isDraft` is false or omitted; optional for drafts.
  - label string (e.g. "What is your name?") - Question label text shown to the user
  - key* string (e.g. "name") - Question key
  - type* string (enum: CUSTOM | CITY | COMPANY_NAME | COUNTRY | DOB | EMAIL | GENDER | FIRST_NAME | FULL_NAME | JOB_TITLE | LAST_NAME | MARITIAL_STATUS | WHATSAPP_NUMBER | EDUCATION_LEVEL | WEBSITE | PHONE | PHONE_OTP | POST_CODE | PROVINCE | RELATIONSHIP_STATUS | STATE | STREET_ADDRESS | ZIP | WORK_EMAIL | MILITARY_STATUS | WORK_PHONE_NUMBER | LOCAL_DEALER | SLIDER | STORE_LOOKUP | STORE_LOOKUP_WITH_TYPEAHEAD | DATE_TIME | ID_CPF | ID_AR_DNI | ID_CL_RUT | ID_CO_CC | ID_EC_CI | ID_PE_DNI | ID_MX_RFC | JOIN_CODE | USER_PROVIDED_PHONE_NUMBER | FACEBOOK_LEAD_ID | EMAIL_ALIAS | MESSENGER | VIN | LICENSE_PLATE | THREAD_LINK | ADDRESS_LINE_TWO | SHORT_ANSWER; e.g. "CUSTOM") - Question input type — use a prefilled type for standard fields or CUSTOM for freeform questions
  - options object[] - Answer options for multiple-choice questions (only applies to CUSTOM type)
    - key* string (e.g. "option 1") - Option key
    - value* string (e.g. "Option 1") - Option value
- questionPageHeadline string (e.g. "Tell us about yourself") - Question page headline
- privacyPolicyLink* string (e.g. "https://example.com/privacy") - Privacy policy URL. Required when `isDraft` is false or omitted; optional for drafts.
- privacyPolicyText string (e.g. "We respect your privacy") - Privacy policy text
- customDisclaimer object - Custom disclaimer config
  - title* string (e.g. "Terms & Conditions") - Disclaimer title
  - body* string (e.g. "By submitting...") - Disclaimer body text
  - checkboxes object[] - Consent checkboxes the user must agree to before submitting the form
    - isRequired* boolean - Checkbox required flag
    - text* string (e.g. "I agree to terms") - Checkbox text label
    - key* string (e.g. "terms_checkbox") - Checkbox unique key
- thankYouPage* object - Thank you page config. Required when `isDraft` is false or omitted; optional for drafts.
  - title* string (e.g. "Thank You!") - Thank you page title
  - body* string (e.g. "We will contact you soon") - Thank you page body
  - buttonText* string (e.g. "Visit Website") - Button text label
  - buttonType* string (enum: VIEW_WEBSITE | CALL_BUSINESS | DOWNLOAD; e.g. "VIEW_WEBSITE") - Thank-you-page button action. `VIEW_WEBSITE` and `DOWNLOAD` use `buttonLink`; `CALL_BUSINESS` uses the business phone number.
  - buttonLink string (e.g. "https://example.com") - Button destination link
  - businessPhone string (e.g. "+1234567890") - Business phone number
  - countryCode string (e.g. "US") - Phone country code
- isDraft boolean - If the form is a draft, set to true
- draftFormId string (e.g. "1234567890") - Draft form ID
- locale string (e.g. "EN_US") - Locale

Response 201 (The stored draft when `isDraft` is set, otherwise the form as published to Facebook) application/json:
- (root) object | object
  - option 1 FacebookCreatedDraftLeadFormDTO: object
    - id* string - Draft id, unprefixed. The listing endpoint reports this same draft as `draft_<id>`.
    - isDraft* boolean - Always true on this branch
    - name* string - Form name
    - locationId* string - Owning location
    - pageId* string - Page the draft will publish to
    - type string (enum: MORE_VOLUME | HIGHER_INTENT) - Lead form objective
    - locale* string - Form locale, upper-cased as stored
    - createdAt* string - Creation time, ISO-8601
    - updatedAt* string - Last modification time, ISO-8601. Equal to `createdAt` on a fresh draft.
    - greetingCard object - Intro card
      - title* string - Greeting headline
      - style* string (enum: LIST_STYLE | PARAGRAPH_STYLE) - Layout of the greeting body
      - content* string[] - Body lines. Rendered as a paragraph or as bullets depending on `style`.
      - _id string - Mongo subdocument id. Internal — do not depend on it.
    - questions object[] - Questions as stored. Each carries a Mongo `_id`, and so does every entry in its `options`.
      - key* string - Field key the answer will be delivered under
      - type* string - Question type
      - label string - Question text. Absent on prefilled questions that have not been given a custom label.
      - options* object[] - Choices. Always present on a draft, empty for anything that is not multiple choice.
        - key* string - Option key
        - value* string - Option display value
      - _id string - Mongo subdocument id. Internal — do not depend on it.
    - questionPageHeadline string - Headline above the questions
    - privacyPolicyLink string - Privacy policy URL
    - privacyPolicyText string - Privacy policy link text
    - customDisclaimer object - Custom disclaimer block
      - title* string - Disclaimer heading
      - body* string - Disclaimer body copy
      - checkboxes object[] - Consent checkboxes shown under the disclaimer
        - key* string - Checkbox key
        - text* string - Checkbox text
        - isRequired* boolean - Whether the user must tick this box to submit
    - thankYouPage object - Confirmation screen
      - title* string - Thank-you headline
      - body* string - Thank-you body copy
      - buttonText* string - Call-to-action button label
      - buttonType* string (enum: VIEW_WEBSITE | CALL_BUSINESS | DOWNLOAD) - Button action. `VIEW_WEBSITE` and `DOWNLOAD` use `buttonLink`; `CALL_BUSINESS` uses the phone number.
      - buttonLink string - Destination URL. Empty string when the button does not link out.
      - businessPhone string - Phone number dialled by a CALL_BUSINESS button
      - countryCode string - Country code for `businessPhone`
  - option 2 FacebookCreatedLeadFormDTO: object
    - id* string - Facebook lead form id
    - name* string - Form name
    - locale* string - Locale, lower-cased by Meta. The draft stored it upper-cased.
    - status* string - Form status on creation
    - createdTime* string - Creation time in the Facebook timestamp format, not the ISO-8601 a draft returns
    - questions* object[] - Questions as Meta stored them, each with a Facebook question id and a resolved label
      - id* string - Facebook question id
      - key* string - Field key the answer is delivered under. Prefilled question types use a fixed key (`full_name`, `email`, `phone`); `CUSTOM` questions get a key derived from the label.
      - label* string - Question text shown to the user
      - type* string - Question type. `CUSTOM` is a free-text or multiple-choice question authored on the form; every other value is a Facebook prefilled field.
      - options object[] - Choices, present only on multiple-choice questions
        - key* string - Option key
        - value* string - Option display value

Errors: 400, 401, 422, 500 (400, 401, 422, 500: see Common error responses)

### Duplicate ad
POST /ad-publishing/facebook/ads/{adId}/duplicate
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/ad-publishing/facebook/ads/{adId}/duplicate
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/ad-publishing/fb-duplicate-ad | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/ad-publishing/fb-duplicate-ad.md

Duplicate an existing Facebook ad

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: adPublishing.write

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Path parameters:
- adId* string (e.g. "507f1f77bcf86cd799439013") - Ad identifier

Request body (required) (application/json) LocationIdBodyDTO:
- locationId* string (e.g. "HChooFuiyPpVYzeJ4HMe") - Location identifier

Response 200 (The duplicated ad, as a new draft) application/json:
- id* string - Ad identifier
- name* string - Ad name
- campaignId* string - Parent campaign id
- adsetId* string - Parent ad set id
- fbAdId string - Facebook ad id, set once published
- publishingStatus* string (enum: DRAFT | SCHEDULED | PUBLISHING | PUBLISHED | PAUSED | IN_REVIEW | WITH_ISSUES | REJECTED | ARCHIVED | FAILED) - Publishing status. On a published entity this is not the state you asked for but the `effective_status` Meta reports, mapped back — a pause or resume re-reads it live, so an ad awaiting review comes back `IN_REVIEW` rather than `PAUSED` or `PUBLISHED`. Any effective status this service does not recognise also maps to `IN_REVIEW`.
- fbError string (nullable) - Publish error from Facebook. `null` on reads when there is none.
- mediaType* string - Creative format
- cta string - Call-to-action button
- multiAdvertiserAds* boolean - Whether multi-advertiser ads are enabled
- primaryTexts* object[] - Primary text variants. Used by SINGLE image and video ads.
  - text* string - Variant text. May be an empty string for an unused slot.
  - _id string - Mongo subdocument id. Note `_id`, not `id` — the transform applies to the top-level document only.
- headlines* object[] - Headline variants
  - text* string - Variant text. May be an empty string for an unused slot.
  - _id string - Mongo subdocument id. Note `_id`, not `id` — the transform applies to the top-level document only.
- descriptions* object[] - Description variants
  - text* string - Variant text. May be an empty string for an unused slot.
  - _id string - Mongo subdocument id. Note `_id`, not `id` — the transform applies to the top-level document only.
- primaryText string - Single primary text. Carried alongside `primaryTexts`, mirroring its first entry.
- headline string - Single headline. Used by carousel ads; mirrors the first `headlines` entry otherwise.
- description string - Single description
- media* object[] - Creative media
  - type* string - Media kind
  - src* string - Source URL of the uploaded file
  - name* string - Original file name
  - _id string - Mongo subdocument id
- destinationFormId string - Instant form the ad routes to, when the conversion location is on-ad
- destinationLink string (nullable) - Click destination. `null` when the ad routes to an instant form instead.
- unpublishedChanges boolean - Whether the ad has edits not yet published
- createdAt* string - Created at
- updatedAt* string - Updated at

Errors: 400, 401, 422, 500 (400, 401, 422, 500: see Common error responses)

- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Path parameters:
- adSetId* string (e.g. "507f1f77bcf86cd799439012") - Ad set identifier

Request body (required) (application/json) LocationIdBodyDTO:
- locationId* string (e.g. "HChooFuiyPpVYzeJ4HMe") - Location identifier

Response 200 (The duplicated ad set as a new draft, with copies of its ads) application/json:
- id* string - Ad set identifier
- name* string - Ad set name
- campaignId* string - Parent campaign id
- fbAdSetId string - Facebook ad set id, set once published
- publishingStatus* string (enum: DRAFT | SCHEDULED | PUBLISHING | PUBLISHED | PAUSED | IN_REVIEW | WITH_ISSUES | REJECTED | ARCHIVED | FAILED) - Publishing status. On a published entity this is not the state you asked for but the `effective_status` Meta reports, mapped back — a pause or resume re-reads it live, so an ad awaiting review comes back `IN_REVIEW` rather than `PAUSED` or `PUBLISHED`. Any effective status this service does not recognise also maps to `IN_REVIEW`.
- fbError string (nullable) - Publish error from Facebook. `null` on reads when there is none.
- pageId* string - Page the ads run under
- instagramActorId string (nullable) - Instagram account the ads run under. `null` when not linked.
- messagingPlatforms* string[] - Messaging destinations for click-to-message ads. Empty for other conversion locations.
- conversionLocation string - Where the conversion happens
- budget* object - Budget configuration
  - budgetType* string - Budget cadence
  - amount* number - Budget amount as entered
  - actualAmount number - Amount actually applied. Differs from `amount` on connect-your-BM pricing.
- audience* object - Targeting
  - genders* number[] - Genders as Facebook numeric codes, not names — `0` all, `1` male, `2` female. Empty array also means all.
  - geoLocations* object[] - Geographic targeting
    - key* string - Facebook location key
    - name* string - Location display name
    - type* string - Location granularity
    - selectionType* string (enum: include | exclude) - Whether the location is targeted or excluded
    - radius number - Targeting radius. `-1` means no radius, used for country-level targeting.
    - radiusUnit string (enum: km | mi) - Unit for the radius
    - geometry object - Geocoded coordinates, stored for address-based targeting and echoed back on reads
      - location* object - Geocoded centre point of the location
      - locationType* string - Precision of the geocoding result
  - ageMin number - Minimum age targeted
  - ageMax number - Maximum age targeted
  - interests object[] - Interest and behaviour targeting
    - id* string - Facebook targeting id
    - name* string - Display name
    - type string - Which targeting taxonomy the entry came from
  - placements object - Placement positions per platform. Only meaningful when `placementType` is `manual`.
  - placementType string (enum: auto | manual) - Placement strategy
- unpublishedChanges boolean - Whether the ad set has edits not yet published
- createdAt* string - Created at
- updatedAt* string - Updated at
- ads* object[] - Ads in this ad set
  - id* string - Ad identifier
  - name* string - Ad name
  - campaignId* string - Parent campaign id
  - adsetId* string - Parent ad set id
  - fbAdId string - Facebook ad id, set once published
  - publishingStatus* string (enum: DRAFT | SCHEDULED | PUBLISHING | PUBLISHED | PAUSED | IN_REVIEW | WITH_ISSUES | REJECTED | ARCHIVED | FAILED) - Publishing status. On a published entity this is not the state you asked for but the `effective_status` Meta reports, mapped back — a pause or resume re-reads it live, so an ad awaiting review comes back `IN_REVIEW` rather than `PAUSED` or `PUBLISHED`. Any effective status this service does not recognise also maps to `IN_REVIEW`.
  - fbError string (nullable) - Publish error from Facebook. `null` on reads when there is none.
  - mediaType* string - Creative format
  - cta string - Call-to-action button
  - multiAdvertiserAds* boolean - Whether multi-advertiser ads are enabled
  - primaryTexts* object[] - Primary text variants. Used by SINGLE image and video ads.
    - text* string - Variant text. May be an empty string for an unused slot.
    - _id string - Mongo subdocument id. Note `_id`, not `id` — the transform applies to the top-level document only.
  - headlines* object[] - Headline variants
    - text* string - Variant text. May be an empty string for an unused slot.
    - _id string - Mongo subdocument id. Note `_id`, not `id` — the transform applies to the top-level document only.
  - descriptions* object[] - Description variants
    - text* string - Variant text. May be an empty string for an unused slot.
    - _id string - Mongo subdocument id. Note `_id`, not `id` — the transform applies to the top-level document only.
  - primaryText string - Single primary text. Carried alongside `primaryTexts`, mirroring its first entry.
  - headline string - Single headline. Used by carousel ads; mirrors the first `headlines` entry otherwise.
  - description string - Single description
  - media* object[] - Creative media
    - type* string - Media kind
    - src* string - Source URL of the uploaded file
    - name* string - Original file name
    - _id string - Mongo subdocument id
  - destinationFormId string - Instant form the ad routes to, when the conversion location is on-ad
  - destinationLink string (nullable) - Click destination. `null` when the ad routes to an instant form instead.
  - unpublishedChanges boolean - Whether the ad has edits not yet published
  - createdAt* string - Created at
  - updatedAt* string - Updated at

Errors: 400, 401, 422, 500 (400, 401, 422, 500: see Common error responses)

### Get campaign publishing progress
GET /ad-publishing/facebook/campaigns/{campaignId}/publishing-progress
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/ad-publishing/facebook/campaigns/{campaignId}/publishing-progress
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/ad-publishing/fb-get-campaign-publishing-progress | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/ad-publishing/fb-get-campaign-publishing-progress.md

Returns Redis-backed publish progress for a campaign while it is publishing to Meta. Used by the validation funnel UI to poll step counts and completion state.

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: adPublishing.readonly

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Path parameters:
- campaignId* string (e.g. "507f1f77bcf86cd799439011") - Campaign identifier

Query parameters:
- locationId* string (e.g. "HChooFuiyPpVYzeJ4HMe") - Location identifier

Response 200 (Publishing progress for the campaign) application/json:
- campaignId* string - Campaign identifier
- publishingStatus* string (enum: DRAFT | SCHEDULED | PUBLISHED | PUBLISHING | FAILED | IN_REVIEW | PAUSED | ARCHIVED | WITH_ISSUES | REJECTED) - Current campaign publishing status in ad-publishing
- total* number - Total publish steps tracked in Redis (campaign + ad sets + ads)
- processed* number - Number of publish steps completed so far
- isComplete* boolean - Whether publishing is finished (Redis complete/failed, processed >= total, or status is no longer PUBLISHING)
- hasFailed* boolean - Whether publishing failed (Redis failed status or campaign FAILED)

Errors: 400, 401, 404, 422, 500 (400, 401, 422, 500: see Common error responses)
Response 404 (Campaign not found): no body

### Get campaign reporting
GET /ad-publishing/facebook/reporting/campaign/{campaignId}
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/ad-publishing/facebook/reporting/campaign/{campaignId}
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/ad-publishing/fb-get-campaign-reporting | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/ad-publishing/fb-get-campaign-reporting.md

Retrieve reporting for one campaign as a flat object, not the `{ grouped, totals }` envelope the account-level report uses. Merges the locally stored campaign, Meta insights for the window, and CDP-attributed contacts. The campaign must be published — one without an `fbCampaignId` is rejected. Note `results.lead` (Meta lead actions) and `leads` (CDP attributed contacts) measure different things and routinely disagree.

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: adPublishing.readonly

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Path parameters:
- campaignId* string (e.g. "507f1f77bcf86cd799439011") - Campaign identifier

Query parameters:
- locationId* string (e.g. "fRMewNQIxSyZ5R4nQyit") - Location identifier
- startDate* string (e.g. "2022-01-11") - Report start date (YYYY-MM-DD)
- endDate* string (e.g. "2022-01-31") - Report end date (YYYY-MM-DD)

Response 200 (Campaign metadata, Meta insights, and attributed contacts for the window) application/json:
- _id* string - Campaign id in this service. Note `_id`, not `id`.
- name* string - Campaign name
- objective* string - Campaign objective
- publishingStatus* string - Local publishing status
- fbCampaignId* string - Meta campaign id. Required — an unpublished campaign is rejected.
- campaignId string - Meta campaign id, repeated from the insights row
- startTime string - When the campaign started, in Meta timestamp format with a numeric offset rather than UTC
- stopTime string - When the campaign is scheduled to stop. Absent on open-ended campaigns.
- dateStart string - First day of the reported window
- dateStop string - Last day of the reported window
- clicks string - Clicks
- cpc string - Cost per click
- ctr string - Click-through rate as a percentage
- cpm string - Cost per thousand impressions
- impressions string - Impressions
- spend string - Spend
- reach string - Unique people reached
- frequency string - Average impressions per person reached
- conversions string - Lead actions Meta recorded. A string here, unlike the account-level report where the same figure is a number.
- costPerConversion string - Spend divided by lead actions
- results map<string, string> - Counts per Meta action type. Values are strings, and the types overlap so summing them double-counts.
- costPerResult string - Spend divided by the double-counted `results` total, so usually far smaller than the real cost per lead
- costPerResultBreakdown map<string, string> - Cost per action, per action type, at four decimals
- leads string - Contacts the CDP attributed to this campaign. A different measurement from `results.lead`, which counts Meta lead actions — expect the two to differ.

Errors: 400, 401, 422, 500 (400, 401, 422, 500: see Common error responses)

### Get custom audience by ID
GET /ad-publishing/facebook/custom-audience/{customAudienceId}
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/ad-publishing/facebook/custom-audience/{customAudienceId}
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/ad-publishing/fb-get-custom-audience-by-id | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/ad-publishing/fb-get-custom-audience-by-id.md

Retrieve one custom audience with its full detail. Returns more than the listing endpoint: Meta adds the fields relevant to the audience subtype (`retentionDays` and `customerFileSource` for customer lists, `rule` and `pixelId` for website audiences, `lookalikeSpec` for lookalikes), and this service appends `extras` describing the local smart-list or CSV source when the audience is a user-provided customer list.

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: adPublishing.readonly

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Path parameters:
- customAudienceId* string (e.g. "23851234567890123") - Custom audience identifier

Query parameters:
- locationId* string (e.g. "HChooFuiyPpVYzeJ4HMe") - Location identifier

Response 200 (The audience with the fields relevant to its subtype) application/json:
- id string - Audience id
- name string - Audience name
- description string - Audience description. Empty string when not set.
- subtype string - How the audience was built. `LOOKALIKE` for lookalikes; `CUSTOM`, `ENGAGEMENT`, `WEBSITE`, and `LEAD` for the rest.
- approximateCountLowerBound number - Lower bound of the audience size. Facebook floors small audiences — `1000` and `20` are placeholders, not counts.
- approximateCountUpperBound number - Upper bound of the audience size
- deliveryStatus object - Whether the audience can be used in a campaign right now
  - code* number - Meta status code. `200` is the healthy case; anything else is explained by `description`.
  - description* string - Human-readable status, safe to show to a user
- operationStatus object - Whether Facebook is still building or refreshing the audience
  - code* number - Meta status code. `200` is the healthy case; anything else is explained by `description`.
  - description* string - Human-readable status, safe to show to a user
- dataSource object - Where the audience gets its members from
  - type* string - How the audience is populated. Passed through from Meta, which does not publish a closed list — `EVENT_BASED`, `SEED_BASED`, and `UNKNOWN` are the values seen in practice, so treat this as an open string rather than an exhaustive enum.
  - subType* string - More specific origin within `type`. Observed pairings are `EVENT_BASED` with `WEB_PIXEL_HITS` or `ENGAGEMENT_EVENTS`, `SEED_BASED` with `PAGE_FANS` or `PLATFORM_USERS`, and `UNKNOWN` with `ANYTHING`, which is what a customer-list upload reports. Also passed through from Meta and not a closed list.
  - creationParams* string - Facebook creation parameters, delivered as a JSON string rather than an object.
- timeCreated number - Creation time as a Unix timestamp in seconds, not milliseconds and not ISO-8601.
- timeUpdated number - Last update time as a Unix timestamp in seconds. Equals `timeCreated` when never edited.
- customerFileSource string - How the member list was supplied. Present on customer-list audiences.
- retentionDays number - How long a member stays in the audience. `0` means members never expire.
- rule object - Matching rule for a website audience, as Meta returns it. Structure varies with the rule and is passed through unchanged.
- pixelId string - Pixel backing a website audience
- lookalikeSpec object - Seed and ratio settings for a lookalike audience, passed through from Meta
- lookalikeAudienceIds string[] - Ids of lookalikes derived from this audience
- extras object - Local sourcing metadata. Added by this service only for user-provided customer lists that have a matching local record; absent otherwise.
  - _id* string - Mongo id of the local record. Internal.
  - locationId* string - Owning location
  - audienceId* string - Meta audience id this record describes
  - type* string (enum: CSV | SMARTLIST) - Where the membership came from
  - dynamic boolean - Whether membership re-syncs as the smart list changes, rather than being a one-off snapshot
  - sourceName string - Display name of the source, used for CSV uploads
  - smartLists object[] - Smart lists feeding the audience. Present for `SMARTLIST` sources.
    - id* string - Smart list id
    - name* string - Smart list name
  - createdAt string - Creation time, ISO-8601
  - updatedAt string - Last modification time, ISO-8601
  - __v number - Mongo version key. Internal — not part of the contract.

Errors: 400, 401, 422, 500 (400, 401, 422, 500: see Common error responses)

### Get custom audiences
GET /ad-publishing/facebook/custom-audience
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/ad-publishing/facebook/custom-audience

Retrieve Facebook custom audiences for a location. Without `limit` the response is a plain array. When `limit` is provided (max 100) the response is a paginated `{ customAudiences, paging }` envelope; pass `after` (from `paging.next`) to fetch the next batch. By default each item is returned in full; pass `projection` (comma-separated, dot-notation for nested fields, e.g. ?projection=id,name,dataSource.type) to return only the requested fields — any value outside the known field set is rejected.

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: adPublishing.readonly

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Query parameters:
- locationId* string (e.g. "loc_abc123") - Location identifier
- type* string (enum: lookalike | custom | all; e.g. "custom") - Audience list type
- source string (enum: ad_manager | integration; e.g. "ad_manager") - Audience data source
- adAccountId* string (e.g. "act_123456") - Ad account identifier
- limit string (e.g. "25") - Page size for a paginated fetch (max 100). When set, the response is a { customAudiences, paging } envelope instead of a plain array.
- after string (e.g. "QVFIU...") - Opaque cursor for the next batch, taken from the previous response paging.next
- projection string[] (enum: id | name | description | approximateCountLowerBound | approximateCountUpperBound | subtype | timeCreated | timeUpdated | dataSource | dataSource.type | dataSource.subType | dataSource.creationParams | deliveryStatus | deliveryStatus.code | deliveryStatus.description | operationStatus | operationStatus.code | operationStatus.description; e.g. ["id","name","dataSource.type","deliveryStatus.code"]) - Fields to return on each item, comma-separated (e.g. ?projection=id,name,dataSource.type). When set, only the requested fields are returned. Nested fields use dot-notation; naming a parent (e.g. dataSource) returns the whole nested object. Any value outside the known field set is rejected. Omit the param entirely to receive the full item as-is.

Response 200 (A plain array of custom audiences (default), or a { customAudiences, paging } envelope when `limit` is provided. Lookalike and custom audiences share one shape — `subtype` distinguishes them. Supplying `projection` narrows every entry to the requested fields only.) application/json:
- (root) object[] | object
  - option 1: object[]
    - id string - Audience id
    - name string - Audience name
    - description string - Audience description. Empty string when not set.
    - subtype string - How the audience was built. `LOOKALIKE` for lookalikes; `CUSTOM`, `ENGAGEMENT`, `WEBSITE`, and `LEAD` for the rest.
    - approximateCountLowerBound number - Lower bound of the audience size. Facebook floors small audiences — `1000` and `20` are placeholders, not counts.
    - approximateCountUpperBound number - Upper bound of the audience size
    - deliveryStatus object - Whether the audience can be used in a campaign right now
      - code* number - Meta status code. `200` is the healthy case; anything else is explained by `description`.
      - description* string - Human-readable status, safe to show to a user
    - operationStatus object - Whether Facebook is still building or refreshing the audience
      - code* number - Meta status code. `200` is the healthy case; anything else is explained by `description`.
      - description* string - Human-readable status, safe to show to a user
    - dataSource object - Where the audience gets its members from
      - type* string - How the audience is populated. Passed through from Meta, which does not publish a closed list — `EVENT_BASED`, `SEED_BASED`, and `UNKNOWN` are the values seen in practice, so treat this as an open string rather than an exhaustive enum.
      - subType* string - More specific origin within `type`. Observed pairings are `EVENT_BASED` with `WEB_PIXEL_HITS` or `ENGAGEMENT_EVENTS`, `SEED_BASED` with `PAGE_FANS` or `PLATFORM_USERS`, and `UNKNOWN` with `ANYTHING`, which is what a customer-list upload reports. Also passed through from Meta and not a closed list.
      - creationParams* string - Facebook creation parameters, delivered as a JSON string rather than an object.
    - timeCreated number - Creation time as a Unix timestamp in seconds, not milliseconds and not ISO-8601.
    - timeUpdated number - Last update time as a Unix timestamp in seconds. Equals `timeCreated` when never edited.
  - option 2 PaginatedFacebookCustomAudiencesDTO: object
    - customAudiences* object[] - Page of Facebook custom audiences
    - paging* object - Pagination cursor
      - next* string (nullable) - Cursor for the next page of results, or null when there are no more pages

### Get entities
GET /ad-publishing/facebook/entity
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/ad-publishing/facebook/entity
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/ad-publishing/fb-get-entity | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/ad-publishing/fb-get-entity.md

Retrieve campaigns, ad sets, or ads for a location. `entityType` selects which, and each returns a `{ data }` envelope whose item shape differs — the id key is `campaignId`, `adSetId`, or `adId` respectively, and the status fields differ too: campaigns carry both `status` and `effectiveStatus`, ad sets only `effectiveStatus`, and ads only `status`. `next` is returned only when the branch pages through Meta, so treat its absence as the end of the results rather than assuming a cursor. For `CAMPAIGN`, `type=INTEGRATION` queries Meta while `type=AD_MANAGER` reads campaigns this service published, filtered to `PAUSED` and `PUBLISHED`. `ADSET` requires `campaignId`; `AD` accepts `adSetId` for a single ad set or `campaignId` to page across the campaign.

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: adPublishing.readonly

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Query parameters:
- locationId* string (e.g. "loc_abc123") - Location identifier
- type* string (enum: AD_MANAGER | INTEGRATION; e.g. "AD_MANAGER") - Integration source type
- next string (e.g. "cursor_abc") - Pagination cursor
- fetchAll string (e.g. "true") - Fetch all entities
- campaignId string (e.g. "camp_123") - Campaign identifier
- adSetId string (e.g. "adset_123") - Ad set identifier
- entityType* string (enum: CAMPAIGN | ADSET | AD; e.g. "CAMPAIGN") - Entity type to fetch
- searchId string (e.g. "search_123") - Search identifier
- selectedAdAccountId string (e.g. "act_123456") - Selected ad account ID

Response 200 (Campaigns, ad sets, or ads, matching the requested `entityType`) application/json:
- (root) object | object | object
  - option 1 FacebookEntityCampaignsResponseDTO: object
    - data* (object | object)[] - Campaigns, shaped by the requested `type`
      - option 1 FacebookEntityCampaignDTO: object
        - campaignId* string - Meta campaign id. Note the key is `campaignId`, not `id`.
        - name* string - Campaign name
        - status* string - Configured status on the campaign
        - effectiveStatus* string - Status Meta actually delivers under. Equals `status` at campaign level, since a campaign has no parent to inherit from.
        - adAccountId* string - Ad account the campaign belongs to
        - locationId* string - Location the lookup was scoped to
      - option 2 FacebookAdManagerEntityCampaignDTO: object
        - campaignId* string - Meta campaign id of the published campaign
        - name* string - Campaign name as stored locally
        - status* string (enum: PAUSED | PUBLISHED) - Local publishing status, not a Meta status
        - adAccountId* string - Ad account the campaign belongs to
        - locationId* string - Owning location
    - next string - Cursor for the next page, to be passed back as `next`. Present only on the `INTEGRATION` branch, and absent once the last page is reached.
  - option 2 FacebookEntityAdsetsResponseDTO: object
    - data* object[] - Ad sets under the requested campaign
      - adSetId* string - Meta ad set id. Note the key is `adSetId`, not `id`.
      - name* string - Ad set name
      - effectiveStatus* string - Status Meta delivers under, including inheritance. `CAMPAIGN_PAUSED` means the parent campaign is paused rather than this ad set.
      - adAccountId* string - Ad account the ad set belongs to
      - locationId* string - Location the lookup was scoped to
  - option 3 FacebookEntityAdsResponseDTO: object
    - data* object[] - Ads under the requested ad set or campaign
      - adId* string - Meta ad id. Note the key is `adId`, not `id`.
      - name* string - Ad name
      - status* string - Configured status on the ad. Delivery state is not reported here — no `effectiveStatus` is fetched for ads.
      - adAccountId* string - Ad account the ad belongs to
      - locationId* string - Location the lookup was scoped to
    - next string - Cursor for the next page. Present only when paging by `campaignId`; absent when `adSetId` was given.

Errors: 400, 401, 422, 500 (400, 401, 422, 500: see Common error responses)

### Get lead form by ID
GET /ad-publishing/facebook/lead-form/{leadFormId}
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/ad-publishing/facebook/lead-form/{leadFormId}
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/ad-publishing/fb-get-lead-form | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/ad-publishing/fb-get-lead-form.md

Retrieve a lead form by id. Pass `isDraft=true` to read an unpublished local draft instead, in which case `leadFormId` accepts either the bare id or the `draft_`-prefixed form the listing endpoint reports. The two branches return different shapes, and neither matches the shape the listing endpoint returns for the same form: the published branch carries the full Meta definition (context card, thank-you page, legal content) but no `status`, `createdTime`, or `pageId`, while the draft branch returns the stored document verbatim under `_id`.

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: adPublishing.readonly

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Path parameters:
- leadFormId* string (e.g. "507f1f77bcf86cd799439011") - Lead form identifier

Query parameters:
- locationId* string (e.g. "HChooFuiyPpVYzeJ4HMe") - Location identifier
- isDraft boolean - Fetch the unpublished draft of this lead form instead of the published form

Response 200 (The published form from Meta, or the stored draft when `isDraft` is set) application/json:
- (root) object | object
  - option 1 FacebookLeadFormDetailDTO: object
    - id* string - Facebook lead form id
    - name* string - Form name
    - locale* string - Form locale, lower-cased by Meta
    - questions* object[] - Questions on the form
      - id* string - Facebook question id
      - key* string - Field key the answer is delivered under. Prefilled question types use a fixed key (`full_name`, `email`, `phone`); `CUSTOM` questions get a key derived from the label.
      - label* string - Question text shown to the user
      - type* string - Question type. `CUSTOM` is a free-text or multiple-choice question authored on the form; every other value is a Facebook prefilled field.
      - options object[] - Choices, present only on multiple-choice questions
        - key* string - Option key
        - value* string - Option display value
    - contextCard object - Intro card shown before the questions. The draft representation calls this `greetingCard`.
      - id* string - Meta id for the card
      - title* string - Card headline
      - content* string[] - Body lines, rendered as a paragraph or bullets depending on `style`
      - style* string (enum: LIST_STYLE | PARAGRAPH_STYLE) - Layout of the body
    - questionPageCustomHeadline string - Headline above the questions. The draft representation calls this `questionPageHeadline`.
    - isOptimizedForQuality boolean - Whether the form uses the higher-intent flow, which adds a review step. Set when the form was created with `type: HIGHER_INTENT`.
    - privacyPolicyUrl string - Privacy policy URL, repeated from `legalContent.privacyPolicy.url`
    - thankYouPage object - Confirmation screen
      - id* string - Meta id for the page
      - title* string - Headline
      - body* string - Body copy
      - buttonText* string - Call-to-action button label
      - buttonType* string (enum: VIEW_WEBSITE | CALL_BUSINESS | DOWNLOAD) - Button action
      - websiteUrl string - Destination URL. The draft representation calls this same value `buttonLink`.
      - enableMessenger boolean - Whether a Messenger hand-off is offered after submit
    - followUpActionUrl string - URL the follow-up action opens
    - followUpActionText string - Label for the follow-up action. Omitted by Meta when unset.
    - legalContent object - Privacy policy and disclaimer
      - id* string - Meta id for the legal block
      - privacyPolicy object - Privacy policy link
        - url* string - Privacy policy URL
        - linkText* string - Link text shown to the user
      - customDisclaimer object - Custom disclaimer block
        - title* string - Disclaimer heading
        - body* map<string, string> - Disclaimer copy, wrapped in an object by Meta rather than returned as a plain string
        - checkboxes object[] - Consent checkboxes shown under the disclaimer
          - id* string - Meta id for the checkbox
          - key* string - Field key the answer is delivered under
          - text* string - Checkbox label
          - isRequired* boolean - Whether the user must tick this to submit
          - isCheckedByDefault* boolean - Whether the box starts ticked
  - option 2 FacebookDraftLeadFormDetailDTO: object
    - _id* string - Draft id, unprefixed and under `_id`. The listing endpoint reports the same draft as `id: draft_<id>`.
    - name* string - Form name
    - locationId* string - Owning location
    - pageId* string - Page the draft will publish to
    - type string (enum: MORE_VOLUME | HIGHER_INTENT) - Lead form objective
    - locale string - Form locale, upper-cased as stored
    - greetingCard object - Intro card
      - title* string - Greeting headline
      - style* string (enum: LIST_STYLE | PARAGRAPH_STYLE) - Layout of the greeting body
      - content* string[] - Body lines. Rendered as a paragraph or as bullets depending on `style`.
      - _id string - Mongo subdocument id. Internal — do not depend on it.
    - questions object[] - Questions as stored
      - key* string - Field key the answer will be delivered under
      - type* string - Question type
      - label string - Question text. Absent on prefilled questions that have not been given a custom label.
      - options* object[] - Choices. Always present on a draft, empty for anything that is not multiple choice.
        - key* string - Option key
        - value* string - Option display value
      - _id string - Mongo subdocument id. Internal — do not depend on it.
    - questionPageHeadline string - Headline above the questions
    - privacyPolicyLink string - Privacy policy URL
    - privacyPolicyText string - Privacy policy link text
    - customDisclaimer object - Custom disclaimer block
      - title* string - Disclaimer heading
      - body* string - Disclaimer body copy
      - checkboxes object[] - Consent checkboxes shown under the disclaimer
        - key* string - Checkbox key
        - text* string - Checkbox text
        - isRequired* boolean - Whether the user must tick this box to submit
    - thankYouPage object - Confirmation screen as stored locally
      - title* string - Thank-you headline
      - body* string - Thank-you body copy

      - buttonType* string (enum: VIEW_WEBSITE | CALL_BUSINESS | DOWNLOAD) - Button action. `VIEW_WEBSITE` and `DOWNLOAD` use `buttonLink`; `CALL_BUSINESS` uses the phone number.
      - buttonLink string - Destination URL. Empty string when the button does not link out.
      - businessPhone string - Phone number dialled by a CALL_BUSINESS button
      - countryCode string - Country code for `businessPhone`
    - createdAt string - Creation time, ISO-8601
    - updatedAt string - Last modification time, ISO-8601
    - __v number - Mongo document version key. Internal — not part of the contract.

### Get page lead forms
GET /ad-publishing/facebook/page/{pageId}/forms
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/ad-publishing/facebook/page/{pageId}/forms
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/ad-publishing/fb-get-page-lead-forms | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/ad-publishing/fb-get-page-lead-forms.md

Retrieve lead gen forms for a specific Facebook page (published + drafts), sorted newest-first by `createdTime`. By default each form is returned in full (including its `questions`) as a plain array; pass `projection` (comma-separated) to return only the requested fields — any value outside the known field set is rejected. Pass `limit` (max 100) for a `{ forms, paging }` envelope; use `after` (from `paging.next`) to fetch the next batch.

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: adPublishing.readonly

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Path parameters:
- pageId* string (e.g. "103456789012345") - Facebook page identifier

Query parameters:
- locationId* string (e.g. "loc_abc123") - Location identifier
- projection string[] (enum: id | name | pageId | status | isDraft | createdTime | locale | page | questions; e.g. ["name","id","pageId","status","isDraft","createdTime"]) - Fields to return on each lead form, comma-separated (e.g. ?projection=name,id,pageId,status,isDraft,createdTime). When set, only the requested fields are returned; any other value is rejected. Omit to receive the full form (including questions) as-is.
- limit string (e.g. "25") - Page size for a paginated fetch (max 100). When set, the response is a { forms, paging } envelope instead of a plain array.
- after string (e.g. "25") - Opaque cursor for the next batch, taken from the previous response paging.next

Response 200 (A plain array of lead forms (default), or a { forms, paging } envelope when `limit` is provided. Each entry is either a form published to Facebook or an unpublished local draft — the two shapes differ, and `isDraft` tells them apart. Supplying `projection` narrows every entry to the requested fields only.) application/json:
- (root) (object | object)[] | object
  - option 1: (object | object)[]
    - option 1 FacebookPublishedLeadFormDTO: object
      - id string - Facebook lead form id
      - name string - Form name
      - locale string - Form locale, lower-cased by Facebook. Note drafts report the same locale upper-cased.
      - status string - Form status. Always `ACTIVE` in this list — the upstream query filters the others out.
      - createdTime string - Creation time in the Facebook timestamp format (`+0000` offset, no sub-second precision). Drafts use ISO-8601 with milliseconds instead, so a client parsing this field must accept both.
      - page object - Page the form belongs to
        - name* string - Page name
        - id* string - Page id
      - pageId string - Page id, repeated from `page.id`
      - questions object[] - Questions on the form
        - id* string - Facebook question id
        - key* string - Field key the answer is delivered under. Prefilled question types use a fixed key (`full_name`, `email`, `phone`); `CUSTOM` questions get a key derived from the label.
        - label* string - Question text shown to the user
        - type* string - Question type. `CUSTOM` is a free-text or multiple-choice question authored on the form; every other value is a Facebook prefilled field.
        - options object[] - Choices, present only on multiple-choice questions
          - key* string - Option key
          - value* string - Option display value
    - option 2 FacebookDraftLeadFormDTO: object
      - id string - Draft id, always prefixed to distinguish it from a Facebook form id
      - isDraft boolean - Always true — this is what marks the entry as an unpublished draft
      - name string - Form name
      - locationId string - Location the draft belongs to
      - pageId string - Page the draft will be published to
      - type string (enum: MORE_VOLUME | HIGHER_INTENT) - Lead form objective
      - locale string - Form locale, upper-cased. Published forms report the same value lower-cased (`en_US`).
      - createdTime string - Creation time in ISO-8601 with milliseconds. Published forms use the Facebook timestamp format.
      - greetingCard object - Intro card shown before the questions
        - title* string - Greeting headline
        - style* string (enum: LIST_STYLE | PARAGRAPH_STYLE) - Layout of the greeting body
        - content* string[] - Body lines. Rendered as a paragraph or as bullets depending on `style`.
        - _id string - Mongo subdocument id. Internal — do not depend on it.
      - questions object[] - Questions on the form
        - key* string - Field key the answer will be delivered under
        - type* string - Question type
        - label string - Question text. Absent on prefilled questions that have not been given a custom label.
        - options* object[] - Choices. Always present on a draft, empty for anything that is not multiple choice.
          - key* string - Option key
          - value* string - Option display value
        - _id string - Mongo subdocument id. Internal — do not depend on it.
      - questionPageHeadline string - Headline above the questions
      - privacyPolicyLink string - Privacy policy URL. Empty string when not set.
      - privacyPolicyText string - Privacy policy link text. Empty string when not set.
      - customDisclaimer object - Optional custom disclaimer block
        - title* string - Disclaimer heading
        - body* string - Disclaimer body copy
        - checkboxes object[] - Consent checkboxes shown under the disclaimer
          - key* string - Checkbox key
          - text* string - Checkbox text
          - isRequired* boolean - Whether the user must tick this box to submit
      - thankYouPage object - Confirmation screen shown after submit
        - title* string - Thank-you headline
        - body* string - Thank-you body copy
        - buttonText* string - Call-to-action button label
        - buttonType* string (enum: VIEW_WEBSITE | CALL_BUSINESS | DOWNLOAD) - Button action. `VIEW_WEBSITE` and `DOWNLOAD` use `buttonLink`; `CALL_BUSINESS` uses the phone number.
        - buttonLink string - Destination URL. Empty string when the button does not link out.
        - businessPhone string - Phone number dialled by a CALL_BUSINESS button
        - countryCode string - Country code for `businessPhone`
  - option 2 PaginatedFacebookLeadFormsDTO: object
    - forms* object[] - Page of Facebook lead forms (sorted by createdTime, newest first). Published forms carry `status`; unsaved drafts carry `isDraft: true` instead, and their `id` is prefixed to distinguish it from a Facebook form id.
    - paging* object - Pagination cursor
      - next* string (nullable) - Cursor for the next page of results, or null when there are no more pages

Errors: 400, 401, 422, 500 (400, 401, 422, 500: see Common error responses)

### Get conversion pixels
GET /ad-publishing/facebook/pixels
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/ad-publishing/facebook/pixels
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/ad-publishing/fb-get-pixels | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/ad-publishing/fb-get-pixels.md

Retrieve Facebook conversion pixels for a location. `channel` selects between two unrelated behaviours. For `FACEBOOK` (the default) the response is `{ items, total }`, or a paginated `{ items, paging }` envelope when `limit` (max 100) is given — pass `after` from `paging.next` for the next batch — and `projection` (comma-separated, from `createdAt`, `fbIsCrmPixel`, `fbPixelCode`, `fbPixelId`, `name`, `type`) narrows each item. For `IG` the response is instead a bare array of Instagram datasets carrying only an id, and `limit`, `after`, and `projection` are ignored.

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: adPublishing.readonly

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Query parameters:
- locationId* string (e.g. "loc_abc123") - Location identifier
- channel string (enum: IG | FACEBOOK; e.g. "FACEBOOK") - Channel type
- pageId string (e.g. "123456789") - Facebook page ID
- igUserId string (e.g. "ig_user_123") - Instagram user ID
- limit string (e.g. "25") - Page size for a paginated fetch (max 100, FACEBOOK channel only). When set, the response is a { items, paging } envelope instead of { items, total }.
- after string (e.g. "QVFIU...") - Opaque cursor for the next batch, taken from the previous response paging.next
- projection string[] (enum: createdAt | fbIsCrmPixel | fbPixelCode | fbPixelId | name | type; e.g. ["fbIsCrmPixel","fbPixelCode"]) - Fields to return on each item, comma-separated (e.g. ?projection=name,fbPixelId). When set, only the requested fields are returned. Selectable fields: createdAt, fbIsCrmPixel, fbPixelCode, fbPixelId, name, type — any other value is rejected. Omit the param entirely to receive the full item as-is.

Response 200 (For channel FACEBOOK, an { items, total } object or an { items, paging } envelope when `limit` is given. For channel IG, a bare array of Instagram datasets, empty when no connected Instagram account matched.) application/json:
- (root) object | object | object[]
  - option 1 FacebookConversionPixelListDTO: object
    - items* object[] - Every pixel on the ad account
      - name string - Pixel (dataset) name as set in Meta
      - fbPixelId string - Meta pixel id
      - fbIsCrmPixel boolean - Whether this pixel is wired to CRM lead events. `type` is derived from this flag alone, so the two fields never disagree — they are the same signal in two spellings.
      - type string (enum: LEAD_EVENT | FUNNEL_EVENT) - Derived from `fbIsCrmPixel`: `LEAD_EVENT` when true, `FUNNEL_EVENT` when false.
      - fbPixelCode string - Ready-to-embed Meta base-code snippet, returned as a raw HTML string containing `<script>` and `<noscript>` tags. It is generated by Meta for embedding as-is; do not render it as page content.
      - createdAt string - Creation time in the Facebook timestamp format, not ISO-8601
    - total* number - Number of entries in `items`
  - option 2 PaginatedFacebookPixelsDTO: object
    - items* object[] - Page of Facebook conversion pixels. Unlike the unpaginated branch this envelope has no `total` — walk `paging.next` to reach the rest.
      - name string - Pixel (dataset) name as set in Meta
      - fbPixelId string - Meta pixel id
      - fbIsCrmPixel boolean - Whether this pixel is wired to CRM lead events. `type` is derived from this flag alone, so the two fields never disagree — they are the same signal in two spellings.
      - type string (enum: LEAD_EVENT | FUNNEL_EVENT) - Derived from `fbIsCrmPixel`: `LEAD_EVENT` when true, `FUNNEL_EVENT` when false.
      - fbPixelCode string - Ready-to-embed Meta base-code snippet, returned as a raw HTML string containing `<script>` and `<noscript>` tags. It is generated by Meta for embedding as-is; do not render it as page content.
      - createdAt string - Creation time in the Facebook timestamp format, not ISO-8601
    - paging* object - Pagination cursor
      - next* string (nullable) - Cursor for the next page of results, or null when there are no more pages
  - option 3: object[]
    - id* string - Instagram dataset id

Errors: 400, 401, 422, 500 (400, 401, 422, 500: see Common error responses)

### Get reporting data
GET /ad-publishing/facebook/reporting
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/ad-publishing/facebook/reporting
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/ad-publishing/fb-get-reporting | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/ad-publishing/fb-get-reporting.md

Retrieve aggregated Facebook ad reporting metrics for a location. `grouped` holds one row per `groupBy` period, or a single row covering the whole range when `groupBy` is omitted, and `totals` aggregates across them. Both objects only carry the metrics named in `fields`. Be aware that ratio metrics (`cpm`, `ctr`, `frequency`) are summed rather than weighted in `totals`, and that `cost_per_conversion` and `cost_per_result` are placeholders that always read `0` — their real values live under `costPerConversion` and `costPerResult`.

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: adPublishing.readonly

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Query parameters:
- locationId* string (e.g. "fRMewNQIxSyZ5R4nQyit") - Location identifier
- fields* string[] (enum: impressions | clicks | spend | cpc | cost_per_conversion | conversions | results | cost_per_result | cpm | reach | frequency | ctr; e.g. ["impressions","clicks","spend"]) - Reporting fields. Pass as comma-separated values on the wire (e.g. ?fields=impressions,clicks).
- groupBy string (enum: day | week | month; e.g. "month") - Time grouping interval
- startDate* string (e.g. "2022-01-11") - Report start date (YYYY-MM-DD)
- endDate* string (e.g. "2022-01-31") - Report end date (YYYY-MM-DD)
- type* string (enum: AD_MANAGER | INTEGRATION; e.g. "INTEGRATION") - Integration source type

Response 200 (Per-period rows and their aggregate totals) application/json:
- grouped* object[] - One row per period when `groupBy` is given, otherwise a single row covering the whole range.
  - dateStart string - First day of the period, inclusive
  - dateStop string - Last day of the period, inclusive. Clamped to the requested `endDate` on the final period.
  - locationId string - Location the report was run for
  - accountId string - Ad account the insights came from
  - impressions string - Impressions, as a string from Meta
  - clicks string - Clicks, as a string from Meta
  - spend string - Spend in account currency, as a string from Meta
  - cpc string - Cost per click. Absent when the period had no clicks rather than reported as zero.
  - cpm string - Cost per thousand impressions
  - ctr string - Click-through rate as a percentage, not a fraction
  - reach string - Unique people reached
  - frequency string - Average impressions per person reached
  - conversions number - Lead actions only, summed. A number here, unlike the string metrics above.
  - results map<string, number> - Counts per Meta action type, keys camelCased from Meta except where the type itself contains a dot (`onsiteConversion.leadGrouped`). These action types overlap by design — `pageEngagement` already contains `postEngagement`, which contains `linkClick` — so summing the values double-counts.
  - costPerConversion number - Cost per lead action for the period
  - costPerResultBreakdown map<string, number> - Cost per action, per action type, for the period
- totals* object - Aggregates across every row in `grouped`
  - impressions string - Summed impressions
  - clicks string - Summed clicks
  - spend string - Summed spend
  - cpc string - Recomputed correctly as total spend divided by total clicks
  - cpm string - Sum of the per-period CPM values, NOT a spend-weighted average. A period with a single impression contributes its whole inflated CPM, so this total can exceed every individual period. Compute `spend / impressions * 1000` yourself if you need the real figure.
  - ctr string - Sum of the per-period CTR percentages, not a weighted average. Same caveat as `cpm`.
  - reach string - Summed reach. Counts a person once per period, so repeats across periods.
  - frequency string - Sum of the per-period frequency values, not a weighted average.
  - conversions number | string - Summed lead actions
    - option 1: number
    - option 2: string
  - cost_per_conversion number - Always the number `0`, never the real value. The field is seeded to zero and the computed figure is written to `costPerConversion` instead, so this key is a placeholder — read `costPerConversion`.
  - costPerConversion string - The real cost per lead: total spend divided by total lead actions.
  - results string - Sum of every value in `resultsBreakdown`. Because Meta action types nest inside one another this double-counts heavily and is not a meaningful count of anything.
  - resultsBreakdown map<string, string> - Counts per action type summed across periods. String values here, unlike the numbers in `grouped`.
  - cost_per_result number - Always the number `0`, never the real value. Read `costPerResult` instead — same placeholder behaviour as `cost_per_conversion`.
  - costPerResult string - Total spend divided by the double-counted `results` total, rounded to two decimals. Because the denominator is inflated this is usually a very small number that rounds to `"0.00"` — the per-action figures in `costPerResultBreakdown` are the usable ones.
  - costPerResultBreakdown map<string, string> - Cost per action, per action type, aggregated as total spend over total count rather than by averaging the per-period ratios. Carries four decimals where the scalar totals carry two.

Errors: 400, 401, 422, 500 (400, 401, 422, 500: see Common error responses)

### Pause ad
POST /ad-publishing/facebook/ads/{adId}/pause
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/ad-publishing/facebook/ads/{adId}/pause
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/ad-publishing/fb-pause-ad | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/ad-publishing/fb-pause-ad.md

Pause a running Facebook ad

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: adPublishing.write

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Path parameters:
- adId* string (e.g. "507f1f77bcf86cd799439013") - Ad identifier

Request body (required) (application/json) LocationIdBodyDTO:
- locationId* string (e.g. "HChooFuiyPpVYzeJ4HMe") - Location identifier

Response 200 (The campaign with its ad sets and their ads) application/json:
- id* string - Campaign identifier
- name* string - Campaign name
- locationId* string - Location identifier
- fbAdAccountId* string - Ad account the campaign belongs to
- fbCampaignId string - Facebook campaign id, set once published
- objective* string - Campaign objective
- specialAdCategories* string[] - Special ad categories declared for the campaign
- publishingStatus* string (enum: DRAFT | SCHEDULED | PUBLISHING | PUBLISHED | PAUSED | IN_REVIEW | WITH_ISSUES | REJECTED | ARCHIVED | FAILED) - Publishing status of the campaign itself. Independent of its children — pausing one ad set leaves the campaign `PUBLISHED`.
- fbError string (nullable) - Despite the name this is not always an error. Reads return `null` when there is nothing to report and the upsert returns `""`, but pausing an ad set or an ad overwrites it with an informational notice — `One or more adsets are paused` or `One or more ads are paused` — which the matching resume clears back to `null`. Treat it as a status line, not a failure signal.
- source* string - Where the campaign was created from
- meta object - Ancillary campaign metadata

### Search targeting options
GET /ad-publishing/facebook/targeting/search
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/ad-publishing/facebook/targeting/search
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/ad-publishing/fb-search-targeting | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/ad-publishing/fb-search-targeting.md

Search Facebook targeting options for ad set audience building. `type` selects which taxonomy is searched and determines the response shape: `geolocation` returns places, `interest` returns interests, behaviours, and demographics, and `language` returns locales. Geolocation and interest results are passed through from Facebook, so their fields are snake_case.

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: adPublishing.readonly

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Query parameters:
- locationId string (e.g. "loc_abc123") - Location identifier
- type* string (enum: geolocation | interest | language; e.g. "interest") - Targeting search type
- query* string (e.g. "fitness") - Search query string
- searchType string (e.g. "adgeolocation") - Specific search subtype

Response 200 (Matching targeting options. The item shape follows the requested `type`: geo results for `geolocation`, interest/behaviour/demographic results for `interest` (sorted by estimated reach, largest first), and locales for `language`.) application/json:
- (root) (object | object | object)[]
  - option 1 FacebookGeoTargetingSearchResultDTO: object
    - key* string - Facebook geo key, used as the targeting id
    - name* string - Location name
    - type* string (enum: country | region | city | subcity | neighborhood | zip | geo_market | electoral_district) - Location granularity
    - country_code string - ISO country code
    - country_name string - Country name
    - region string - Region or state name
    - region_id number - Numeric region id
    - supports_region boolean - Whether region-level targeting is available here
    - supports_city boolean - Whether city-level targeting is available here
    - geo_hierarchy_level string - Position in the geo hierarchy. Absent on plain cities.
    - geo_hierarchy_name string - Hierarchy label. Can differ from `geo_hierarchy_level` — a SUBCITY reports CITY here.
  - option 2 FacebookInterestTargetingSearchResultDTO: object
    - id* string - Facebook targeting id
    - name* string - Display name
    - type* string (enum: interests | behaviors | demographics | education_majors | education_schools | work_employers | work_positions) - Targeting field this entry must be sent under when building an ad set audience
    - subText* string (enum: interests | behaviors | demographics) - Category label for grouping in a picker. `interests` for the interest taxonomy, otherwise the source class.
    - path* string[] - Taxonomy breadcrumb from the root to this entry
    - description* string (nullable) - Explanation of who the entry matches. Empty string or null when Facebook has no copy for it.
    - audience_size_lower_bound number - Lower bound of the estimated reach
    - audience_size_upper_bound number - Upper bound of the estimated reach
    - topic string - Broad topic the interest sits under
    - disambiguation_category string - Qualifier Facebook adds when the name alone is ambiguous
    - real_time_cluster boolean - Facebook internal clustering flag, on behaviour entries only
  - option 3 FacebookLanguageTargetingSearchResultDTO: object
    - key* number - Facebook locale id, used as the targeting value
    - name* string - Language name

Errors: 400, 401, 422, 500 (400, 401, 422, 500: see Common error responses)

### Upsert ad
PUT /ad-publishing/facebook/ads
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/ad-publishing/facebook/ads
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/ad-publishing/fb-upsert-ad | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/ad-publishing/fb-upsert-ad.md

Create or update a Facebook ad

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: adPublishing.write

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Request body (required) (application/json) UpsertAdDTO:
- id string (e.g. "ad_123") - Ad identifier
- locationId* string (e.g. "loc_abc123") - Location identifier
- name string (e.g. "My Ad Creative") - Ad name
- primaryText string (e.g. "Check out our offer!") - Single primary text. Normalised into `primaryTexts` when that array is empty, so send `primaryTexts` instead unless you have exactly one variant.
- headline string (e.g. "Great Deal") - Ad-level headline for CAROUSEL ads — used for any card that does not set its own `media[].headline`. SINGLE (image and video) ads take their headline from the `headlines` array instead.
- description string (e.g. "Limited time offer") - Single ad description. SINGLE (image and video) ads take their description from the `descriptions` array, and carousel cards from `media[].description`.
- imageUrl string (e.g. "https://example.com/img.jpg") - Ad image URL
- mediaType string (enum: SINGLE | CAROUSEL; e.g. "SINGLE") - Ad media type
- media object[] - Media items (images or videos) attached to the ad creative
  - src* string (e.g. "https://example.com/image.jpg") - Media source URL
  - thumbnailUrl string (e.g. "https://example.com/thumb.jpg") - Thumbnail URL (required when type is video)
  - selectedPoster number (e.g. 0) - Selected poster index (required when type is video)
  - type* string (enum: image | video; e.g. "image") - Media content type
  - name string (e.g. "ad_image.jpg") - Media file name
  - headline string (e.g. "Great Offer") - Media headline
  - description string (e.g. "Click to learn more") - Media description
  - link string (e.g. "https://example.com") - Media destination link
- multiAdvertiserAds boolean - Enable multi-advertiser ads
- campaignId* string (e.g. "camp_123") - Parent campaign ID
- adsetId* string (e.g. "adset_123") - Parent ad set ID
- cta string (e.g. "LEARN_MORE") - Call-to-action button. Valid values depend on the parent campaign objective (and, for sales, the ad set `conversionLocation`) — OUTCOME_LEADS: `APPLY_NOW`, `DOWNLOAD`, `GET_OFFER`, `GET_QUOTE`, `LEARN_MORE`, `SIGN_UP`, `SUBSCRIBE`; OUTCOME_TRAFFIC: `APPLY_NOW`, `BOOK_TRAVEL`, `BUY_NOW`, `CONTACT_US`, `GET_OFFER`, `GET_PROMOTIONS`, `GET_QUOTE`, `LEARN_MORE`, `NO_BUTTON`, `ORDER_NOW`, `SHOP_NOW`, `SIGN_UP`, `SUBSCRIBE`; OUTCOME_ENGAGEMENT: `APPLY_NOW`, `BOOK_TRAVEL`, `CONTACT_US`, `GET_PROMOTIONS`, `GET_QUOTE`, `INQUIRE_NOW`, `LEARN_MORE`, `MESSAGE_PAGE`, `ORDER_NOW`, `SEND_UPDATES`, `SHOP_NOW`, `SIGN_UP`, `SUBSCRIBE`; OUTCOME_SALES with `conversionLocation: messaging`: `APPLY_NOW`, `BOOK_TRAVEL`, `CONTACT_US`, `GET_QUOTE`, `LEARN_MORE`, `MESSAGE_PAGE`, `ORDER_NOW`, `PLAY_GAME`, `SHOP_NOW`, `SIGN_UP`, `SUBSCRIBE`; OUTCOME_SALES with `conversionLocation: website`: `APPLY_NOW`, `BOOK_TRAVEL`, `BUY_TICKETS`, `CONTACT_US`, `GET_OFFER`, `GET_QUOTE`, `GET_SHOWTIMES`, `LEARN_MORE`, `LISTEN_NOW`, `ORDER_NOW`, `PLAY_GAME`, `SHOP_NOW`, `SIGN_UP`, `SUBSCRIBE`, `WATCH_MORE`. Note `BOOK_TRAVEL` is the "Book now" button. Not validated server-side, so values outside this set are forwarded to Facebook and may be rejected there.
- conversationFormId string (e.g. "conv_123") - Conversation form ID
- destinationLink string (e.g. "https://example.com") - Destination link URL
- destinationFormId string (e.g. "form_123") - Destination form ID
- primaryTexts object[] - Primary text variants. Used by every media type. Supply more than one to run Facebook text variations; with a single entry it becomes the ad message. Prefer this over the singular `primaryText`.
  - text* string (e.g. "Automation Test Primary Text") - Primary text variant
- headlines object[] - Headline variants. Applies to SINGLE (image and video) ads only — carousel ads take their per-card headline from `media[].headline`, falling back to the singular `headline`. Supply more than one to run Facebook text variations.
  - text* string (e.g. "Automation Test Headline") - Headline variant
- descriptions object[] - Description variants. Applies to SINGLE (image and video) ads only — carousel ads take their per-card description from `media[].description`. Supply more than one to run Facebook text variations.
  - text* string (e.g. "Automation Test Description") - Description variant

Response 200 (The saved ad) application/json:
- id* string - Ad identifier
- name* string - Ad name
- campaignId* string - Parent campaign id
- adsetId* string - Parent ad set id
- fbAdId string - Facebook ad id, set once published
- publishingStatus* string (enum: DRAFT | SCHEDULED | PUBLISHING | PUBLISHED | PAUSED | IN_REVIEW | WITH_ISSUES | REJECTED | ARCHIVED | FAILED) - Publishing status. On a published entity this is not the state you asked for but the `effective_status` Meta reports, mapped back — a pause or resume re-reads it live, so an ad awaiting review comes back `IN_REVIEW` rather than `PAUSED` or `PUBLISHED`. Any effective status this service does not recognise also maps to `IN_REVIEW`.
- fbError string (nullable) - Publish error from Facebook. `null` on reads when there is none.
- mediaType* string - Creative format
- cta string - Call-to-action button
- multiAdvertiserAds* boolean - Whether multi-advertiser ads are enabled
- primaryTexts* object[] - Primary text variants. Used by SINGLE image and video ads.
  - text* string - Variant text. May be an empty string for an unused slot.
  - _id string - Mongo subdocument id. Note `_id`, not `id` — the transform applies to the top-level document only.
- headlines* object[] - Headline variants
  - text* string - Variant text. May be an empty string for an unused slot.

  - text* string - Variant text. May be an empty string for an unused slot.
  - _id string - Mongo subdocument id. Note `_id`, not `id` — the transform applies to the top-level document only.
- primaryText string - Single primary text. Carried alongside `primaryTexts`, mirroring its first entry.

  - type* string - Media kind
