    - name* string (e.g. "Website Visitors - Last 30 Days") - Custom audience name
  - retargeting object[] - Retargeting custom audiences to target
    - id* string (e.g. "23851234567890") - Custom audience ID
    - name* string (e.g. "Website Visitors - Last 30 Days") - Custom audience name
  - interests object[] - Interest-based targeting criteria
    - id* string (e.g. "6003139266461") - Interest ID
    - name* string (e.g. "Fitness and wellness") - Interest name
    - type string (e.g. "interests") - Interest category type (defaults to "interests" if omitted)
  - ageMin number (e.g. 18) - Minimum age for targeting
  - ageMax number (e.g. 65) - Maximum age for targeting
  - genders number[] (e.g. [1,2]) - Gender targeting (1 = male, 2 = female)
- budget object - Ad set budget config; schedule only under a campaign budget
  - budgetType string (enum: DAILY | LIFETIME; e.g. "DAILY") - Budget type
  - amount number (e.g. 100) - Ad set budget in account currency
  - scheduleStartDate string (e.g. "2024-01-01") - Schedule start date
  - scheduleEndDate string (e.g. "2024-01-31") - Schedule end date
- bidAmount number (e.g. 2.5) - Bid cap or cost-per-result goal in account currency. Required when the campaign bid strategy is LOWEST_COST_WITH_BID_CAP or COST_CAP.
- conversionLocation string (e.g. "website") - Where the conversion happens. Valid values depend on the parent campaign objective — OUTCOME_LEADS: `on_ad` (instant form), `website`, `website_and_lead_form`; OUTCOME_SALES: `website` (pixel), `messaging`. Not validated server-side, so values outside this set are forwarded to Facebook and may be rejected there.
- customEventType string (e.g. "PURCHASE") - Facebook standard event optimised for. Only meaningful when `conversionLocation` is `website` (requires `pixelId`). Valid values depend on the parent campaign objective — OUTCOME_LEADS: `COMPLETE_REGISTRATION`, `CONTACT`, `CONTENT_VIEW`, `FIND_LOCATION`, `LEAD`, `SCHEDULE`, `SEARCH`, `START_TRIAL`, `SUBMIT_APPLICATION`, `SUBSCRIBE`; OUTCOME_SALES: `ADD_PAYMENT_INFO`, `ADD_TO_CART`, `ADD_TO_WISHLIST`, `COMPLETE_REGISTRATION`, `CONTENT_VIEW`, `DONATE`, `INITIATED_CHECKOUT`, `PURCHASE`, `SEARCH`, `START_TRIAL`, `SUBSCRIBE`. Not validated server-side, so values outside this set are forwarded to Facebook and may be rejected there.
- pixelId string (e.g. "px_123") - Conversion pixel ID
- campaignId* string (e.g. "camp_123") - Parent campaign ID

Response 200 (The saved ad set) application/json:
- id* string - Ad set identifier
- name* string - Ad set name
- campaignId* string - Parent campaign id
- fbAdSetId string - Facebook ad set id, set once published
- publishingStatus* string (enum: DRAFT | SCHEDULED | PUBLISHING | PUBLISHED | PAUSED | IN_REVIEW | WITH_ISSUES | REJECTED | ARCHIVED | FAILED) - Publishing status. On a published entity this is not the state you asked for but the `effective_status` Meta reports, mapped back — a pause or resume re-reads it live, so an ad awaiting review comes back `IN_REVIEW` rather than `PAUSED` or `PUBLISHED`. Any effective status this service does not recognise also maps to `IN_REVIEW`.
- fbError string (nullable) - Publish error from Facebook. `null` on reads when there is none.
- pageId* string - Page the ads run under
- instagramActorId string (nullable) - Instagram account the ads run under. `null` when not linked.
- messagingPlatforms* string[] - Messaging destinations for click-to-message ads. Empty for other conversion locations.
- conversionLocation string - Where the conversion happens
- budget* object - Budget configuration
  - budgetType* string - Budget cadence
  - amount* number - Budget amount as entered
  - actualAmount number - Amount actually applied. Differs from `amount` on connect-your-BM pricing.
- audience* object - Targeting
  - genders* number[] - Genders as Facebook numeric codes, not names — `0` all, `1` male, `2` female. Empty array also means all.
  - geoLocations* object[] - Geographic targeting
    - key* string - Facebook location key
    - name* string - Location display name
    - type* string - Location granularity
    - selectionType* string (enum: include | exclude) - Whether the location is targeted or excluded
    - radius number - Targeting radius. `-1` means no radius, used for country-level targeting.
    - radiusUnit string (enum: km | mi) - Unit for the radius
    - geometry object - Geocoded coordinates, stored for address-based targeting and echoed back on reads
      - location* object - Geocoded centre point of the location
      - locationType* string - Precision of the geocoding result
  - ageMin number - Minimum age targeted
  - ageMax number - Maximum age targeted
  - interests object[] - Interest and behaviour targeting
    - id* string - Facebook targeting id
    - name* string - Display name
    - type string - Which targeting taxonomy the entry came from
  - placements object - Placement positions per platform. Only meaningful when `placementType` is `manual`.
  - placementType string (enum: auto | manual) - Placement strategy
- unpublishedChanges boolean - Whether the ad set has edits not yet published
- createdAt* string - Created at
- updatedAt* string - Updated at

Errors: 400, 401, 422, 500 (400, 401, 422, 500: see Common error responses)

### Upsert campaign
PUT /ad-publishing/facebook/campaigns
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/ad-publishing/facebook/campaigns
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/ad-publishing/fb-upsert-campaign | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/ad-publishing/fb-upsert-campaign.md

Create or update a Facebook campaign

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: adPublishing.write

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Request body (required) (application/json) UpsertCampaignDTO:
- id string (e.g. "camp_123") - Campaign identifier
- locationId* string (e.g. "loc_abc123") - Location identifier
- name string (e.g. "Summer Campaign") - Campaign name
- objective string (enum: OUTCOME_LEADS | OUTCOME_TRAFFIC | OUTCOME_ENGAGEMENT | OUTCOME_SALES; e.g. "OUTCOME_LEADS") - Campaign objective
- specialAdCategories string[] (enum: EMPLOYMENT | CREDIT | FINANCIAL_PRODUCTS_SERVICES | HOUSING | ISSUES_ELECTIONS_POLITICS | ONLINE_GAMBLING_AND_GAMING | NONE; e.g. ["NONE"]) - Special ad categories
- isCampaignBudget boolean - Advantage campaign budget. When true the campaign carries `budget` and `bidStrategy`, and ad sets carry no budget of their own.
- budget object - Campaign-level budget (Advantage campaign budget). Requires isCampaignBudget.
  - budgetType* string (enum: DAILY | LIFETIME; e.g. "DAILY") - Budget type
  - amount* number (e.g. 1000) - Budget amount in account currency, greater than zero
  - scheduleStartDate string (e.g. "2024-01-01") - Schedule start date
  - scheduleEndDate string (e.g. "2024-01-31") - Schedule end date
- bidStrategy string (enum: LOWEST_COST_WITHOUT_CAP | LOWEST_COST_WITH_BID_CAP | COST_CAP; e.g. "LOWEST_COST_WITHOUT_CAP") - Campaign-level bid strategy. Only with isCampaignBudget.
- bidAmount number (e.g. 2.5) - Default bid cap / cost-per-result goal in account currency for every ad set; an ad set's own bidAmount wins. Only with isCampaignBudget or adsetBudgetSharing.
- adsetBudgetSharing boolean - Ad set budget sharing: Meta may move up to 20% of an ad set budget to sibling ad sets. Mutually exclusive with isCampaignBudget.
- source string (e.g. "facebook") - Campaign data source
- customValueMappings object - User-provided overrides for custom_values merge tags used in ad copy

Response 200 (The saved campaign, without its ad sets) application/json:
- id* string - Campaign identifier
- name* string - Campaign name
- locationId* string - Location identifier
- fbAdAccountId* string - Ad account the campaign belongs to
- fbCampaignId string - Facebook campaign id, set once published
- objective* string - Campaign objective
- specialAdCategories* string[] - Special ad categories declared for the campaign
- publishingStatus* string (enum: DRAFT | SCHEDULED | PUBLISHING | PUBLISHED | PAUSED | IN_REVIEW | WITH_ISSUES | REJECTED | ARCHIVED | FAILED) - Publishing status of the campaign itself. Independent of its children — pausing one ad set leaves the campaign `PUBLISHED`.
- fbError string (nullable) - Despite the name this is not always an error. Reads return `null` when there is nothing to report and the upsert returns `""`, but pausing an ad set or an ad overwrites it with an informational notice — `One or more adsets are paused` or `One or more ads are paused` — which the matching resume clears back to `null`. Treat it as a status line, not a failure signal.
- source* string - Where the campaign was created from
- meta object - Ancillary campaign metadata
  - evaluate string - Opportunity-score result, stored as a JSON **string** rather than an object — parse before use. On Facebook it additionally carries `sacCompliance`, which is absent on Google and LinkedIn.
- unpublishedChanges boolean - Whether the campaign has edits not yet published
- createdAt* string - Created at
- updatedAt* string - Updated at

Errors: 400, 401, 422, 500 (400, 401, 422, 500: see Common error responses)

### Upsert conversion pixel
PUT /ad-publishing/facebook/pixels
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/ad-publishing/facebook/pixels
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/ad-publishing/fb-upsert-pixel | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/ad-publishing/fb-upsert-pixel.md

Create a Facebook conversion pixel, or rename an existing one by passing `conversionPixelId`. The two paths acknowledge differently: a create returns the new id, a rename returns only `{ success: true }`. Renaming is the only update supported, and it rejects `type: INSTAGRAM_DM`. Creating an `INSTAGRAM_DM` dataset requires `igUserId` and fails if one already exists for that account.

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: adPublishing.write

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Request body (required) (application/json) UpsertConversionPixelDTO:
- locationId* string (e.g. "loc_abc123") - Location identifier
- conversionPixelId string (e.g. "px_123") - Conversion pixel ID
- name string (e.g. "My Pixel") - Pixel name
- igUserId string (e.g. "ig_user_123") - Instagram user ID
- type* string (enum: LEAD_EVENT | FUNNEL_EVENT | INSTAGRAM_DM; e.g. "LEAD_EVENT") - Pixel event type

Response 200 (The new id when a pixel was created, or a success flag when an existing pixel was renamed) application/json:
- (root) object | object
  - option 1 FacebookUpsertPixelCreatedDTO: object
    - id* string - Id of the pixel or dataset that was created
  - option 2 FacebookUpsertPixelUpdatedDTO: object
    - success* boolean - True when the rename was applied

Errors: 400, 401, 422, 500 (400, 401, 422, 500: see Common error responses)

    - exclusionDimension* object - Exclusion targeting

      - scope* string - Scope the audience is defined at

        - isAgeUnknown boolean - Whether users of unknown age are included. Omitted when not set.
        - isHouseHoldIncomeUnknown boolean - Whether users of unknown household income are included. Omitted when not set.
      - exclusionDimension* object - Exclusion targeting
        - userLists* string[] - User list resource names excluded from the audience
    - paging* object - Pagination cursor

URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/ad-publishing/google/reporting/campaign/{campaignId}
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/ad-publishing/google-get-campaign-reporting | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/ad-publishing/google-get-campaign-reporting.md

Retrieve reporting metrics for a specific Google campaign

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: adPublishing.readonly

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Path parameters:
- campaignId* string (e.g. "507f1f77bcf86cd799439011") - Campaign identifier

Query parameters:
- locationId* string (e.g. "fRMewNQIxSyZ5R4nQyit") - Location identifier
- startDate* string (e.g. "2022-01-11") - Report start date
- endDate* string (e.g. "2022-01-31") - Report end date

Response 200 (Per-day metric rows for the campaign, plus its identity and serving window) application/json:
- grouped* object[] - Per-day metric rows
  - campaign* object - Campaign the row belongs to
    - resourceName* string - Google Ads resource name
    - startDate* string - Campaign start date
    - endDate* string - Campaign end date. Google uses a far-future date such as 2037-12-30 for open-ended campaigns.
  - metrics* object - Metrics for the day
    - impressions number | string - Impressions
      - option 1: number
      - option 2: string
    - clicks number | string - Clicks
      - option 1: number
      - option 2: string
    - costMicros number | string - Spend in micros — divide by 1,000,000 for account currency
      - option 1: number
      - option 2: string
    - averageCpc number - Average cost per click, in micros
    - conversions number - Conversions
    - averageCpm number - Average cost per thousand impressions, in micros
    - costPerConversion number - Cost per conversion, in micros
    - ctr number - Click-through rate as a fraction, not a percentage
  - segments map<string, string> - The day this row covers. Absent on the synthetic row returned when Google reports no activity for the window — that row carries only `campaign` and an empty `metrics`.
- campaignId* string - Google Ads campaign id
- name* string - Campaign name
- publishingStatus* string - Publishing status held by this product
- objective* string - Advertising channel the campaign runs on
- startTime* string - When the campaign started serving
- stopTime* string - When the campaign stopped serving
- leads* string - Attributed leads count, as a string

Errors: 400, 401, 422, 500 (400, 401, 422, 500: see Common error responses)

Retrieve Google Ads conversion goals for a location. Without `limit` the response is a plain array. When `limit` is provided (max 100, default 100) the response is a paginated `{ conversionGoals, paging }` envelope; pass `pageToken` (from `paging.next`) to fetch the next batch.

### Get conversions
GET /ad-publishing/google/conversions
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/ad-publishing/google/conversions
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/ad-publishing/google-get-conversions | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/ad-publishing/google-get-conversions.md

Retrieve Google Ads conversion actions for a location. The response shape is selected by `type`. When `type` is `AD_MANAGER`: without `limit` a plain array of full conversion actions, and with `limit` (max 100, default 100) a paginated `{ conversions, paging }` envelope — pass `pageToken` (from `paging.next`) for the next batch. When `type` is omitted or `AD_WORDS`, a different, minimal snake_case projection is returned and `limit`, `pageToken`, `startDate`, `endDate`, `conversionType` and `category` are all ignored.

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: adPublishing.readonly

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Query parameters:
- locationId* string (e.g. "loc_abc123") - Location identifier
- type string (enum: AD_MANAGER | AD_WORDS; e.g. "AD_MANAGER") - Integration type
- conversionType string (enum: UPLOAD_CLICKS | UPLOAD_CALLS | WEBPAGE | LEAD_FORM_SUBMIT | AD_CALL; e.g. "WEBPAGE") - Conversion action type to filter by
- category string (enum: DEFAULT | PAGE_VIEW | PURCHASE | SIGNUP | LEAD | DOWNLOAD | ADD_TO_CART | BEGIN_CHECKOUT | SUBSCRIBE_PAID | PHONE_CALL_LEAD | IMPORTED_LEAD | SUBMIT_LEAD_FORM | BOOK_APPOINTMENT | REQUEST_QUOTE | GET_DIRECTIONS | OUTBOUND_CLICK | CONTACT | ENGAGEMENT | STORE_VISIT | STORE_SALE | QUALIFIED_LEAD | CONVERTED_LEAD; e.g. "PURCHASE") - Conversion action category to filter by
- startDate string (e.g. "2024-01-01") - Filter start date
- endDate string (e.g. "2024-12-31") - Filter end date
- limit string (e.g. "100") - Page size for a paginated fetch (max 100, defaults to 100). When set, the response is a { conversions, paging } envelope instead of a plain array. Applies to AD_MANAGER type only.
- pageToken string (e.g. "100") - Opaque cursor for the next batch, taken from the previous response paging.next

Response 200 (Minimal array when type is omitted/AD_WORDS, a full array for AD_MANAGER, or a { conversions, paging } envelope for AD_MANAGER with limit) application/json:
- (root) object[] | object[] | object
  - option 1: object[]
    - conversion_action_id* string - Google Ads conversion action id
    - conversion_name* string - Conversion action name
    - conversion_source* string - Always `UPLOAD` on this branch
  - option 2: object[]
    - id* string - Google Ads conversion action id
    - resourceName* string - Google Ads resource name
    - name* string - Conversion action name
    - status* string - Conversion action status
    - type* string (enum: UPLOAD_CLICKS | UPLOAD_CALLS | WEBPAGE | LEAD_FORM_SUBMIT | AD_CALL) - Conversion action type
    - countingType* string (enum: ONE_PER_CLICK | MANY_PER_CLICK) - How conversions are counted per click
    - defaultValue* number - Default conversion value, 0 when unset
    - defaultCurrencyCode* string - ISO currency for the default value. `XXX` is the ISO code for "no currency" and appears when unset.
    - includeInConversionsMetric* boolean - Whether this action feeds the Conversions reporting metric
    - allConversions* number - All-conversions count for the requested window
    - allConversionsValue* number - All-conversions value for the requested window
    - category* string (enum: DEFAULT | PAGE_VIEW | PURCHASE | SIGNUP | LEAD | DOWNLOAD | ADD_TO_CART | BEGIN_CHECKOUT | SUBSCRIBE_PAID | PHONE_CALL_LEAD | IMPORTED_LEAD | SUBMIT_LEAD_FORM | BOOK_APPOINTMENT | REQUEST_QUOTE | GET_DIRECTIONS | OUTBOUND_CLICK | CONTACT | ENGAGEMENT | STORE_VISIT | STORE_SALE | QUALIFIED_LEAD | CONVERTED_LEAD) - Conversion action category
    - primaryForGoal* boolean - Whether the action is primary for its conversion goal
  - option 3 PaginatedGoogleConversionsDTO: object
    - conversions* object[] - Page of conversion actions
      - id* string - Google Ads conversion action id
      - resourceName* string - Google Ads resource name
      - name* string - Conversion action name
      - status* string - Conversion action status
      - type* string (enum: UPLOAD_CLICKS | UPLOAD_CALLS | WEBPAGE | LEAD_FORM_SUBMIT | AD_CALL) - Conversion action type
      - countingType* string (enum: ONE_PER_CLICK | MANY_PER_CLICK) - How conversions are counted per click
      - defaultValue* number - Default conversion value, 0 when unset
      - defaultCurrencyCode* string - ISO currency for the default value. `XXX` is the ISO code for "no currency" and appears when unset.
      - includeInConversionsMetric* boolean - Whether this action feeds the Conversions reporting metric
      - allConversions* number - All-conversions count for the requested window
      - allConversionsValue* number - All-conversions value for the requested window
      - category* string (enum: DEFAULT | PAGE_VIEW | PURCHASE | SIGNUP | LEAD | DOWNLOAD | ADD_TO_CART | BEGIN_CHECKOUT | SUBSCRIBE_PAID | PHONE_CALL_LEAD | IMPORTED_LEAD | SUBMIT_LEAD_FORM | BOOK_APPOINTMENT | REQUEST_QUOTE | GET_DIRECTIONS | OUTBOUND_CLICK | CONTACT | ENGAGEMENT | STORE_VISIT | STORE_SALE | QUALIFIED_LEAD | CONVERTED_LEAD) - Conversion action category
      - primaryForGoal* boolean - Whether the action is primary for its conversion goal
    - paging* object - Pagination cursor
      - next* string (nullable) - Offset cursor for the next page, or null when there are no more pages

Errors: 400, 401, 422, 500 (400, 401, 422, 500: see Common error responses)

Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/ad-publishing/google-get-entity | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/ad-publishing/google-get-entity.md

Retrieve Google campaigns, ad groups, or ads based on entity type

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: adPublishing.readonly

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Query parameters:
- locationId* string (e.g. "loc_abc123") - Location identifier
- type* string (enum: AD_MANAGER | INTEGRATION; e.g. "AD_MANAGER") - Integration type
- campaignId string (e.g. "196684453527082") - Campaign identifier
- adGroupId string (e.g. "123456789") - Ad group identifier
- entityType* string (enum: CAMPAIGN | ADGROUP | AD; e.g. "CAMPAIGN") - Entity type
- searchId string (e.g. "123,456") - Comma-separated Google Ads IDs to filter by
- startDate string (e.g. "2024-01-01") - Filter start date
- endDate string (e.g. "2024-12-31") - Filter end date
- selectedAdAccountId string (e.g. "123-456-7890") - Selected ad account ID

Response 200 (A { data } envelope whose items follow entityType — campaigns, ad groups, or ads) application/json:
- data (object | object | object)[] - Campaigns, ad groups, or ads, shaped by the requested `entityType`
  - option 1 GoogleEntityCampaignDTO: object
    - resourceName* string - Google Ads resource name
    - id* string - Campaign id
    - name* string - Campaign name
    - status* string - Campaign status
  - option 2 GoogleEntityAdGroupDTO: object
    - resourceName* string - Google Ads resource name
    - id* string - Ad group id
    - name* string - Ad group name
    - status* string - Ad group status
  - option 3 GoogleEntityAdDTO: object
    - resourceName* string - Google Ads resource name
    - id* string - Ad id
    - name* string - Display name, derived from the ad headline where available and falling back to `Ad - {id}`
    - type* string - Google Ads ad type

Errors: 400, 401, 422, 500 (400, 401, 422, 500: see Common error responses)

### Get reporting data
GET /ad-publishing/google/reporting
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/ad-publishing/google/reporting
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/ad-publishing/google-get-reporting | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/ad-publishing/google-get-reporting.md

Retrieve aggregated Google Ads reporting metrics for a location

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: adPublishing.readonly

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Query parameters:
- locationId* string (e.g. "fRMewNQIxSyZ5R4nQyit") - Location identifier
- fields* string[] (enum: impressions | clicks | cost_micros | average_cpc | conversions | average_cpm | cost_per_conversion | ctr; e.g. ["impressions","clicks","cost_micros"]) - Reporting fields. Pass as comma-separated values on the wire (e.g. ?fields=impressions,clicks).
- groupBy string (enum: date | week | month; e.g. "month") - Group by period
- startDate* string (e.g. "2022-01-11") - Report start date
- endDate* string (e.g. "2022-01-31") - Report end date
- type* string (enum: AD_MANAGER | INTEGRATION; e.g. "INTEGRATION") - Integration type

Response 200 (Metrics grouped by the requested interval, plus totals. Only the requested `fields` appear.) application/json:
- grouped* object[] - One entry per time bucket
  - segments* map<string, string> - The bucket this row covers. The key follows `groupBy` — `date`, `week` or `month` — and the value is the first day of the bucket.
  - metrics* object - Metrics for the bucket
    - impressions number | string - Impressions
      - option 1: number
      - option 2: string
    - clicks number | string - Clicks
      - option 1: number
      - option 2: string
    - costMicros number | string - Spend in micros — divide by 1,000,000 for account currency
      - option 1: number
      - option 2: string
    - averageCpc number - Average cost per click, in micros
    - conversions number - Conversions
    - averageCpm number - Average cost per thousand impressions, in micros
    - costPerConversion number - Cost per conversion, in micros
    - ctr number - Click-through rate as a fraction, not a percentage
- totals* object - Metrics summed across every bucket
  - impressions number | string - Impressions
    - option 1: number
    - option 2: string
  - clicks number | string - Clicks
    - option 1: number
    - option 2: string
  - costMicros number | string - Spend in micros — divide by 1,000,000 for account currency
    - option 1: number
    - option 2: string
  - averageCpc number - Average cost per click, in micros
  - conversions number - Conversions
  - averageCpm number - Average cost per thousand impressions, in micros
  - costPerConversion number - Cost per conversion, in micros
  - ctr number - Click-through rate as a fraction, not a percentage

Errors: 400, 401, 422, 500 (400, 401, 422, 500: see Common error responses)

### Get segment by ID
GET /ad-publishing/google/segments/{segmentId}
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/ad-publishing/google/segments/{segmentId}
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/ad-publishing/google-get-segment-by-id | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/ad-publishing/google-get-segment-by-id.md

Retrieve a specific Google Ads audience segment by ID

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: adPublishing.readonly

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Path parameters:
- segmentId* string (e.g. "seg_abc123") - Segment identifier

Query parameters:
- locationId* string (e.g. "HChooFuiyPpVYzeJ4HMe") - Location identifier
- type* string (enum: CUSTOM_SEGMENTS | DATA_SEGMENTS; e.g. "CUSTOM_SEGMENTS") - Segment type

Response 200 (The segment, shaped by the requested `type`. `CUSTOM_SEGMENTS` returns a custom audience with `status` and `members`; `DATA_SEGMENTS` returns a Google user list with rules, sizes, access metadata, and an optional `extras` block holding this product's own record.) application/json:
- (root) object | object
  - option 1 GoogleSegmentDetailDTO: object
    - resourceName* string - Google Ads resource name
    - id* string - Segment id
    - status* string - Segment status
    - name* string - Segment name
    - type* string - Google custom-audience type. `AUTO` is the default applied when none is supplied on create.
    - members* object[] - Keywords, URLs and apps that define the segment
      - memberType* string (enum: KEYWORD | URL | APP) - Which member field is populated on this entry
      - keyword string - Keyword, present when memberType is KEYWORD
      - url string - URL, present when memberType is URL
      - app string - App identifier, present when memberType is APP
  - option 2 GoogleDataSegmentDetailDTO: object
    - resourceName* string - Google Ads resource name
    - id* string - User list id
    - name* string - User list name
    - type* string (enum: CRM_BASED | RULE_BASED | LOOKALIKE | LOGICAL | EXTERNAL_REMARKETING | SIMILAR) - How the list is populated. Unlike the listing endpoint, this value is not remapped.
    - description string - User list description
    - readOnly boolean - Whether the list can be edited through the API
    - accessReason string (enum: OWNED | SHARED) - Whether the account owns the list or it was shared in
    - sizeForDisplay string - Display-network size, returned as a string rather than a number
    - sizeForSearch string - Search-network size, returned as a string rather than a number
    - basicUserList object - Tag actions backing a basic list. Present for basic user lists only.
    - ruleBasedUserList object - Rule definition and pre-population status. Present for rule-based lists, and carries the flexible-rule operands when the list uses them.
    - crmBasedUserList object - Source app for a CRM-based list. Present for CRM_BASED lists only.
    - logicalUserList object - Combination rules. Present for LOGICAL lists only.
    - lookalikeUserList object - Seed lists, country codes, and expansion level. Present for LOOKALIKE lists only.
    - extras object - This product's own record of the list, merged in when one exists locally. Absent for lists this service did not create.

Errors: 400, 401, 422, 500 (400, 401, 422, 500: see Common error responses)

### Get segments
GET /ad-publishing/google/segments
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/ad-publishing/google/segments
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/ad-publishing/google-get-segments | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/ad-publishing/google-get-segments.md

Retrieve Google Ads audience segments for a location. Without `limit` the response is a plain array. When `limit` is provided (max 100, default 100) the response is a paginated `{ segments, paging }` envelope; pass `pageToken` (from `paging.next`) to fetch the next batch.

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: adPublishing.readonly

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Query parameters:
- locationId* string (e.g. "loc_abc123") - Location identifier
- type string (enum: CUSTOM_SEGMENTS | DATA_SEGMENTS | ALL; e.g. "CUSTOM_SEGMENTS") - Segment type
- limit string (e.g. "100") - Page size for a paginated fetch (max 100, defaults to 100). When set, the response is a { segments, paging } envelope instead of a plain array.
- pageToken string (e.g. "100") - Opaque cursor for the next batch, taken from the previous response paging.next

Response 200 (A plain array of segments (default), or a { segments, paging } envelope when `limit` is provided) application/json:
- (root) (object | object)[] | object
  - option 1: (object | object)[]
    - option 1 GoogleCustomSegmentSummaryDTO: object
      - resourceName* string - Google Ads resource name
      - id* string - Segment id
      - name* string - Segment name
      - status* string - Segment status
      - type* string (enum: CUSTOM_SEGMENTS) - Always the literal `CUSTOM_SEGMENTS`. The service overwrites Google's own type with this constant so the value can be used as the discriminator that tells custom-audience entries apart from user-list entries in the merged `ALL` listing.
      - interestType string (enum: AUTO | INTEREST | PURCHASE_INTENT | SEARCH | UNKNOWN | UNSPECIFIED) - Google's own custom-audience type, moved here because `type` is reused as the discriminator.
      - description string - Segment description
    - option 2 GoogleDataSegmentDTO: object
      - resourceName* string - Google Ads resource name
      - id* string - User list id
      - name* string - User list name
      - type* string (enum: CRM_BASED | WEBSITE_VISITOR | LOOKALIKE | LOGICAL | YOUTUBE) - How the list is populated
      - status* string - User list status
      - membershipStatus* string - Whether the list is open to new members
      - accessReason* string (enum: OWNED | SHARED) - Whether the account owns the list or it was shared in
      - accountUserListStatus* string - Status of the list within this account
      - readOnly* boolean - Whether the list can be edited through the API
      - sizeForDisplay* string - Display-network size, returned as a string rather than a number
      - sizeForSearch* string - Search-network size, returned as a string rather than a number
      - ruleBasedUserList object - Rule metadata. Present only for rule-based lists such as WEBSITE_VISITOR and YOUTUBE.
        - prepopulationStatus* string - Whether Google has finished pre-populating the list from historical traffic
      - logicalUserList object - Combination metadata. Present only for LOGICAL lists, and returned empty.
  - option 2 PaginatedGoogleSegmentsDTO: object
    - segments* (object | object)[] - Page of audience segments. Entries are custom audiences or user lists depending on the requested `type`; `ALL` returns both shapes in one array.
      - option 1 GoogleCustomSegmentSummaryDTO: object
        - resourceName* string - Google Ads resource name
        - id* string - Segment id
        - name* string - Segment name
        - status* string - Segment status
        - type* string (enum: CUSTOM_SEGMENTS) - Always the literal `CUSTOM_SEGMENTS`. The service overwrites Google's own type with this constant so the value can be used as the discriminator that tells custom-audience entries apart from user-list entries in the merged `ALL` listing.
        - interestType string (enum: AUTO | INTEREST | PURCHASE_INTENT | SEARCH | UNKNOWN | UNSPECIFIED) - Google's own custom-audience type, moved here because `type` is reused as the discriminator.
        - description string - Segment description
      - option 2 GoogleDataSegmentDTO: object
        - resourceName* string - Google Ads resource name
        - id* string - User list id
        - name* string - User list name
        - type* string (enum: CRM_BASED | WEBSITE_VISITOR | LOOKALIKE | LOGICAL | YOUTUBE) - How the list is populated
        - status* string - User list status
        - membershipStatus* string - Whether the list is open to new members
        - accessReason* string (enum: OWNED | SHARED) - Whether the account owns the list or it was shared in
        - accountUserListStatus* string - Status of the list within this account
        - readOnly* boolean - Whether the list can be edited through the API
        - sizeForDisplay* string - Display-network size, returned as a string rather than a number
        - sizeForSearch* string - Search-network size, returned as a string rather than a number
        - ruleBasedUserList object - Rule metadata. Present only for rule-based lists such as WEBSITE_VISITOR and YOUTUBE.
          - prepopulationStatus* string - Whether Google has finished pre-populating the list from historical traffic
        - logicalUserList object - Combination metadata. Present only for LOGICAL lists, and returned empty.
    - paging* object - Pagination cursor
      - next* string (nullable) - Cursor for the next page of results, or null when there are no more pages

Errors: 400, 401, 422, 500 (400, 401, 422, 500: see Common error responses)

### Get target interests
GET /ad-publishing/google/target-interests
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/ad-publishing/google/target-interests
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/ad-publishing/google-get-target-interests | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/ad-publishing/google-get-target-interests.md

Retrieve affinity and in-market audience options for Google Ads targeting. Without `limit` the response is a plain array of root interests (each with a nested children tree). When `limit` is provided (max 100) the response is a paginated `{ targetInterests, paging }` envelope — a page counts root interests; pass `pageToken` (from `paging.next`) to fetch the next batch. By default each node is returned in full; pass `projection` (comma-separated, e.g. ?projection=name,userInterestId,children) to return only the requested fields — selecting `children` prunes the whole tree recursively with the same selection, and any value outside the known field set is rejected.

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: adPublishing.readonly

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Query parameters:
- locationId* string (e.g. "HChooFuiyPpVYzeJ4HMe") - Location identifier
- type* string (enum: AFFINITY | IN_MARKET; e.g. "AFFINITY") - Interest type
- advertisingChannelType* string (e.g. "SEARCH") - Channel type
- limit string (e.g. "100") - Page size for a paginated fetch (max 100). When set, the response is a { targetInterests, paging } envelope instead of a plain array. Counts root interests — each root includes its full children tree.
- pageToken string (e.g. "100") - Opaque cursor for the next batch, taken from the previous response paging.next
- projection string[] (enum: resourceName | taxonomyType | userInterestId | name | userInterestParent | availabilities | children; e.g. ["name","userInterestId","children"]) - Fields to return on each interest node, comma-separated (e.g. ?projection=name,userInterestId,children). When set, only the requested fields are returned. Selecting `children` prunes the whole tree recursively with the same selection; `availabilities` returns the whole array. Any value outside the known field set is rejected. Omit the param entirely to receive the full node as-is.

Response 200 (A plain array of root interests (default), or a { targetInterests, paging } envelope when `limit` is provided) application/json:
- (root) object[] | object
  - option 1: object[]
  - option 2 PaginatedGoogleTargetInterestsDTO: object
    - targetInterests* object[] - Page of root Google Ads target interests, each with a nested children tree
    - paging* object - Pagination cursor
      - next* string (nullable) - Cursor for the next page of results, or null when there are no more pages

Errors: 400, 401, 422, 500 (400, 401, 422, 500: see Common error responses)

### Publish ad
POST /ad-publishing/google/ads/{adId}/publish
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/ad-publishing/google/ads/{adId}/publish
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/ad-publishing/google-publish-ad | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/ad-publishing/google-publish-ad.md

Publish a Google ad and push it live

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: adPublishing.write

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Path parameters:
- adId* string (e.g. "507f1f77bcf86cd799439011") - Ad identifier

Request body (required) (application/json) LocationIdBodyDTO:
- locationId* string (e.g. "HChooFuiyPpVYzeJ4HMe") - Location identifier

Response 200 (The campaign moved to PUBLISHING. Returns the raw document, so the id is `_id` and `adGroups` are not populated.) application/json:
- _id* string - Campaign identifier, as `_id` rather than `id`
- __v* number - Mongoose internal version key
- name* string - Campaign name
- locationId* string - Location identifier
- googleAdAccountId* string - Google Ads customer id
- advertisingChannelType* string (enum: SEARCH | DEMAND_GEN) - Advertising channel
- publishingStatus* string (enum: DRAFT | SCHEDULED | PUBLISHED | PUBLISHING | FAILED | IN_REVIEW | PAUSED | ARCHIVED | WITH_ISSUES | REJECTED) - Status after the publish request, normally `PUBLISHING`
- source* string - Where the campaign was created from
- budget* object - Budget configuration
  - budgetType* string - Budget cadence
  - amount* number - Budget amount in account currency
  - scheduleStartDate string - Schedule start
  - scheduleEndDate string - Schedule end
- networkSettings* object - Network placement settings
  - targetSearchNetwork* boolean - Serve on the Search network
  - targetContentNetwork* boolean - Serve on the Display/content network
- biddingStrategy* object - Bidding configuration. `value` is omitted for strategies that do not take a target.
  - type* string - Bidding strategy
  - value* number - Target value for the strategy, 0 when unset
- assets* object - Attached assets by kind
- audience* object - Campaign level targeting
  - locales* object[] - Language targeting
    - name string - Language display name
    - key string - Language key
    - id string - Language identifier
    - resourceName string - Language resource name
  - geoLocations* object[] - Geographic targeting
    - key string - Geo target constant resource name
    - id string - Location identifier (place_id)
    - name string - Location display name
    - countryName string - Country name
    - type string - Location type (city, region, country, address, etc.)
    - radius number - Radius for proximity targeting
    - radiusUnit string (enum: km | mi) - Radius unit
    - selectionType string (enum: include | exclude) - Include or exclude this location
    - resourceName string - Google Ads resource name
    - placeId string - Google place ID
    - formattedAddress string - Full formatted address string
    - geometry object - Geometry data from Google Geocoding API
      - location object - Location coordinates
        - lat number - Latitude
        - lng number - Longitude
      - locationType string - Location type (e.g. APPROXIMATE)
      - viewport object - Viewport bounding box
        - northeast object - Northeast corner of the viewport
          - lat number - Latitude
          - lng number - Longitude
        - southwest object - Southwest corner of the viewport
          - lat number - Latitude
          - lng number - Longitude
    - addressComponents object[] - Address components from Google Geocoding API
      - longName string - Full name of the address component
      - shortName string - Abbreviated name of the address component
      - types string[] - Address component types
  - gender object[] - Gender targeting
    - enum* string (enum: MALE | FEMALE | UNDETERMINED) - Gender to target
    - negative* boolean - Whether this is a negative target
  - ageRange object[] - Age range targeting
    - enum* string (enum: AGE_RANGE_18_24 | AGE_RANGE_25_34 | AGE_RANGE_35_44 | AGE_RANGE_45_54 | AGE_RANGE_55_64 | AGE_RANGE_65_UP | AGE_RANGE_UNDETERMINED) - Age bucket to target
    - negative* boolean - Whether this is a negative target
  - segments string[] - Audience segment resource names
  - targetInterests object - Affinity and in-market interests
    - affinity* string[] - Affinity audience resource names
    - inMarket* string[] - In-market audience resource names
- adSchedule* object[] - Ad scheduling windows
  - dayOfWeek* string (enum: FRIDAY | MONDAY | SATURDAY | SUNDAY | THURSDAY | TUESDAY | UNKNOWN | UNSPECIFIED | WEDNESDAY | ALL_DAYS | MONDAY_TO_FRIDAY | SATURDAY_AND_SUNDAY) - Day or day-group the window applies to
  - from* string - Window start as `HH_MM` with an underscore separator, not a colon
  - to* string - Window end as `HH_MM` with an underscore separator
  - _id string - Mongo subdocument id. Note this is `_id`, not `id` — the id transform applies to the top-level document only.
- meta object - Ancillary campaign metadata
  - evaluate string - Opportunity-score result, stored as a JSON **string** rather than an object — parse before use. Present only after the campaign has been evaluated.
- googleError string (nullable) - Publish error from Google, null when the request was accepted
- isEuPoliticalAds* boolean - Whether the campaign is declared as EU political advertising
- createdBy* string - User who created the campaign
- updatedBy* string - User who last updated the campaign
- createdAt* string - Created at
- updatedAt* string - Updated at

Errors: 400, 401, 422, 500 (400, 401, 422, 500: see Common error responses)

### Upsert assets
POST /ad-publishing/google/assets
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/ad-publishing/google/assets
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/ad-publishing/google-upsert-assets | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/ad-publishing/google-upsert-assets.md

Create or update Google Ads creative assets

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: adPublishing.write

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Request body (required) (application/json) UpsertAssetsDTO:
- locationId* string (e.g. "loc_abc123") - Location identifier
- type* string (enum: CALL | SITELINK; e.g. "CALL") - Asset type to create or update
- payload* object | object - Asset payload — shape depends on the type field: CallAssetPayload (CALL) or SitelinkAssetPayload (SITELINK)
  - option 1 CallAssetPayloadDTO: object
    - phoneNumber* string (e.g. "+14155551234") - Phone number for call ads
    - countryCode* string (e.g. "US") - Two-letter ISO country code
    - callConversionAction string (e.g. "customers/123/conversionActions/456") - Call conversion action resource name
    - adScheduleTargets object[] - Ad schedule targets restricting when the call asset is shown
      - startMinute* string (enum: ZERO | FIFTEEN | THIRTY | FORTY_FIVE; e.g. "ZERO") - Minute mark the schedule starts at
      - endMinute* string (enum: ZERO | FIFTEEN | THIRTY | FORTY_FIVE; e.g. "ZERO") - Minute mark the schedule ends at
      - dayOfWeek* string (enum: MONDAY | TUESDAY | WEDNESDAY | THURSDAY | FRIDAY | SATURDAY | SUNDAY; e.g. "MONDAY") - Day of the week for this schedule
      - startHour* number (e.g. 9) - Start hour in 24h format (0-23)
      - endHour* number (e.g. 17) - End hour in 24h format (0-23)
    - resourceName string (e.g. "customers/123/assets/456") - Google Ads resource name for an existing call asset
  - option 2 SitelinkAssetPayloadDTO: object
    - resourceName string (e.g. "customers/123/assets/456") - Google Ads resource name for an existing sitelink asset
    - linkText* string (e.g. "Pricing") - Sitelink display text
    - finalUrls* string (e.g. "https://example.com/pricing") - Final landing page URL
    - description1 string (e.g. "See our plans and pricing") - First description line
    - description2 string (e.g. "Starting at $9/month") - Second description line
    - startDate string (e.g. "2024-01-01") - Start date for the sitelink (YYYY-MM-DD)
    - endDate string (e.g. "2024-12-31") - End date for the sitelink (YYYY-MM-DD)
    - adScheduleTargets object[] - Ad schedule targets restricting when the sitelink is shown
      - startMinute* string (enum: ZERO | FIFTEEN | THIRTY | FORTY_FIVE; e.g. "ZERO") - Minute mark the schedule starts at
      - endMinute* string (enum: ZERO | FIFTEEN | THIRTY | FORTY_FIVE; e.g. "ZERO") - Minute mark the schedule ends at
      - dayOfWeek* string (enum: MONDAY | TUESDAY | WEDNESDAY | THURSDAY | FRIDAY | SATURDAY | SUNDAY; e.g. "MONDAY") - Day of the week for this schedule
      - startHour* number (e.g. 9) - Start hour in 24h format (0-23)
      - endHour* number (e.g. 17) - End hour in 24h format (0-23)

Response 200 (Resource name of the created or updated asset) application/json:
- resourceName* string - Resource name of the created or updated record

Errors: 400, 401, 422, 500 (400, 401, 422, 500: see Common error responses)

### Upsert audience
PUT /ad-publishing/google/audiences
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/ad-publishing/google/audiences
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/ad-publishing/google-upsert-audience | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/ad-publishing/google-upsert-audience.md

Create or update a Google Ads combined audience

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: adPublishing.write

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Request body (required) (application/json) UpsertAudienceDTO:
- locationId* string (e.g. "loc_abc123") - Location identifier
- resourceName string (e.g. "customers/123/audiences/456") - Audience resource name
- name* string (e.g. "My Audience") - Audience name
- dimensions object - Audience dimensions
  - isAgeUnknown boolean - Include unknown age
  - ageRanges object[] - Age range filter. Only the first entry is applied. Google accepts fixed buckets, so `minAge` must be one of 18, 25, 35, 45, 55, 65 and `maxAge`, when supplied, one of 24, 34, 44, 54, 64; `minAge` must be less than `maxAge`. Omit `maxAge` for the open-ended 65+ bucket. Values outside these are rejected with 400. Note this is the user-list age shape and differs from the `AGE_RANGE_*` strings used for campaign demographic targeting.
    - minAge* number (enum: 18 | 25 | 35 | 45 | 55 | 65; e.g. 25) - Lower bound of the age bucket, inclusive
    - maxAge number (enum: 24 | 34 | 44 | 54 | 64; e.g. 34) - Upper bound of the age bucket, inclusive. Omit for the open-ended 65+ bucket.
  - genders string[] (enum: MALE | FEMALE | UNDETERMINED; e.g. ["MALE","FEMALE"]) - Gender targets
  - parentalStatuses string[] (enum: PARENT | NOT_A_PARENT | UNDETERMINED; e.g. ["PARENT"]) - Parental status targets
  - audienceSegments object - Audience segment references used for targeting
    - customAudiences string[] (e.g. ["customers/123/customAudiences/456"]) - Resource names of custom audience segments
    - userLists string[] (e.g. ["customers/123/userLists/789"]) - Resource names of user lists (remarketing lists, customer match lists, etc.)
    - userInterests string[] (e.g. ["customers/123/userInterests/321"]) - Resource names of user interest segments (in-market or affinity audiences)
- exclusionDimension object - Exclusion dimensions
  - isAgeUnknown boolean - Include unknown age
  - ageRanges object[] - Age range filter. Only the first entry is applied. Google accepts fixed buckets, so `minAge` must be one of 18, 25, 35, 45, 55, 65 and `maxAge`, when supplied, one of 24, 34, 44, 54, 64; `minAge` must be less than `maxAge`. Omit `maxAge` for the open-ended 65+ bucket. Values outside these are rejected with 400. Note this is the user-list age shape and differs from the `AGE_RANGE_*` strings used for campaign demographic targeting.
    - minAge* number (enum: 18 | 25 | 35 | 45 | 55 | 65; e.g. 25) - Lower bound of the age bucket, inclusive
    - maxAge number (enum: 24 | 34 | 44 | 54 | 64; e.g. 34) - Upper bound of the age bucket, inclusive. Omit for the open-ended 65+ bucket.
  - genders string[] (enum: MALE | FEMALE | UNDETERMINED; e.g. ["MALE","FEMALE"]) - Gender targets
  - parentalStatuses string[] (enum: PARENT | NOT_A_PARENT | UNDETERMINED; e.g. ["PARENT"]) - Parental status targets
  - audienceSegments object - Audience segment references used for targeting
    - customAudiences string[] (e.g. ["customers/123/customAudiences/456"]) - Resource names of custom audience segments
    - userLists string[] (e.g. ["customers/123/userLists/789"]) - Resource names of user lists (remarketing lists, customer match lists, etc.)
    - userInterests string[] (e.g. ["customers/123/userInterests/321"]) - Resource names of user interest segments (in-market or affinity audiences)

Response 200 (Google Ads mutate results for the created or updated audience — an array, not the audience itself) application/json:
- (root) object[]
  - resourceName* string - Resource name of the affected record, as returned by the Google Ads mutate call

Errors: 400, 401, 422, 500 (400, 401, 422, 500: see Common error responses)

### Upsert conversion
PUT /ad-publishing/google/conversions
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/ad-publishing/google/conversions
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/ad-publishing/google-upsert-conversion | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/ad-publishing/google-upsert-conversion.md

Create or update a Google Ads conversion action

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: adPublishing.write

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Request body (required) (application/json) UpsertConversionDTO:
- locationId* string (e.g. "loc_abc123") - Location identifier
- conversionId string (e.g. "conv_456") - Conversion identifier
- name* string (e.g. "Purchase Conversion") - Conversion name
- type* string (enum: UPLOAD_CLICKS; e.g. "UPLOAD_CLICKS") - Conversion action type. Only `UPLOAD_CLICKS` is supported — the conversion list endpoint reads back UPLOAD_CLICKS actions only, so a conversion created with any other type would never be returned.
- category* string (enum: DEFAULT | PAGE_VIEW | PURCHASE | SIGNUP | LEAD | DOWNLOAD | ADD_TO_CART | BEGIN_CHECKOUT | SUBSCRIBE_PAID | PHONE_CALL_LEAD | IMPORTED_LEAD | SUBMIT_LEAD_FORM | BOOK_APPOINTMENT | REQUEST_QUOTE | GET_DIRECTIONS | OUTBOUND_CLICK | CONTACT | ENGAGEMENT | STORE_VISIT | STORE_SALE | QUALIFIED_LEAD | CONVERTED_LEAD; e.g. "PURCHASE") - Conversion action category
- valueSettings* object - Value settings that control how monetary value is attributed to conversions
  - defaultValue* number (e.g. 10) - Default monetary value assigned to each conversion
  - defaultCurrencyCode* string (e.g. "USD") - ISO 4217 currency code for the default value
  - alwaysUseDefaultValue* boolean - When true, always uses the default value even if a transaction-specific value is provided
- countingType* string (enum: ONE_PER_CLICK | MANY_PER_CLICK; e.g. "ONE_PER_CLICK") - How conversions are counted per interaction
- attributionModel* string (enum: GOOGLE_SEARCH_ATTRIBUTION_DATA_DRIVEN | GOOGLE_ADS_LAST_CLICK; e.g. "GOOGLE_ADS_LAST_CLICK") - Attribution model used to credit conversions
- clickThroughWindow* number (e.g. 30) - Click-through conversion window in days

Response 200 (Resource name of the created or updated conversion action) application/json:
- resourceName* string - Resource name of the created or updated record

Errors: 400, 401, 422, 500 (400, 401, 422, 500: see Common error responses)

### Upsert segment
PUT /ad-publishing/google/segments
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/ad-publishing/google/segments
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/ad-publishing/google-upsert-segment | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/ad-publishing/google-upsert-segment.md

Create or update a Google Ads audience segment

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: adPublishing.write

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Query parameters:
- locationId* string (e.g. "HChooFuiyPpVYzeJ4HMe") - Location identifier
- type* string (enum: CUSTOM_SEGMENTS | WEBSITE_VISITOR | CUSTOMER_MATCH | LOOKALIKE; e.g. "CUSTOM_SEGMENTS") - Segment type

Request body (required) (application/json) UpsertSegmentDTO:
- name* string (e.g. "My Segment") - Segment name
- description string (e.g. "Target audience segment") - Segment description
- members object[] - Segment members — keywords, URLs, or apps that define the custom segment
  - memberType* string (enum: KEYWORD | URL | APP; e.g. "KEYWORD") - Member type
  - keyword string (e.g. "marketing") - Keyword value
  - url string (e.g. "https://example.com") - URL value
  - app string (e.g. "com.example.app") - App identifier
- status string (e.g. "ENABLED") - Segment status
- type string (e.g. "AUTO") - Google custom-audience type, used only when the `type` query parameter is `CUSTOM_SEGMENTS`. Defaults to `AUTO` when omitted. This is NOT the same field as the `type` query parameter, which selects which kind of segment to upsert — settable values here are `AUTO`, `INTEREST`, `PURCHASE_INTENT` and `SEARCH`.
- id string (e.g. "seg_123") - Segment identifier
- membershipStatus string (e.g. "OPEN") - Membership status
- ruleBasedUserList object - Rule-based user list config
  - prepopulationStatus string (enum: REQUESTED; e.g. "REQUESTED") - Prepopulation status
  - flexibleRuleUserList* object - Flexible rule user list configuration
    - inclusiveRuleOperator string (e.g. "AND") - Operator for combining inclusive operands
    - inclusiveOperands* object[] - Inclusive rule operands
      - lookbackWindowDays* number (e.g. 30) - Lookback window in days
      - rule* object - Rule definition
        - ruleItemGroups* object[] - List of rule item groups
          - ruleItems* object[] - List of rule items
            - name* string (enum: url__ | referrer__; e.g. "url__") - Rule item name
            - stringRuleItem* object - String rule item condition
              - operator* string (e.g. "CONTAINS") - Rule operator
              - value* string (e.g. "/products") - Rule value
    - exclusiveOperands* object[] - Exclusive rule operands
      - lookbackWindowDays* number (e.g. 30) - Lookback window in days
      - rule* object - Rule definition
        - ruleItemGroups* object[] - List of rule item groups
          - ruleItems* object[] - List of rule items
            - name* string (enum: url__ | referrer__; e.g. "url__") - Rule item name
            - stringRuleItem* object - String rule item condition
              - operator* string (e.g. "CONTAINS") - Rule operator
              - value* string (e.g. "/products") - Rule value
- membershipLifeSpan number (e.g. 30) - Membership life span
- seedUserListIds string[] (e.g. ["list_1"]) - Seed user list IDs
- countryCodes string[] (e.g. ["US","CA"]) - Country codes
- expansionLevel string (enum: BALANCED | BROAD | NARROW; e.g. "BALANCED") - Expansion level

Response 200 (The saved segment, shaped by the requested `type`: a custom audience for `CUSTOM_SEGMENTS`, or a Google user list for `DATA_SEGMENTS`.) application/json:
- (root) object | object
  - option 1 GoogleSegmentDetailDTO: object
    - resourceName* string - Google Ads resource name
    - id* string - Segment id
    - status* string - Segment status
    - name* string - Segment name
    - type* string - Google custom-audience type. `AUTO` is the default applied when none is supplied on create.
    - members* object[] - Keywords, URLs and apps that define the segment
      - memberType* string (enum: KEYWORD | URL | APP) - Which member field is populated on this entry
      - keyword string - Keyword, present when memberType is KEYWORD
      - url string - URL, present when memberType is URL
      - app string - App identifier, present when memberType is APP
  - option 2 GoogleDataSegmentDetailDTO: object
    - resourceName* string - Google Ads resource name
    - id* string - User list id
    - name* string - User list name
    - type* string (enum: CRM_BASED | RULE_BASED | LOOKALIKE | LOGICAL | EXTERNAL_REMARKETING | SIMILAR) - How the list is populated. Unlike the listing endpoint, this value is not remapped.
    - description string - User list description
    - readOnly boolean - Whether the list can be edited through the API
    - accessReason string (enum: OWNED | SHARED) - Whether the account owns the list or it was shared in
    - sizeForDisplay string - Display-network size, returned as a string rather than a number
    - sizeForSearch string - Search-network size, returned as a string rather than a number
    - basicUserList object - Tag actions backing a basic list. Present for basic user lists only.
    - ruleBasedUserList object - Rule definition and pre-population status. Present for rule-based lists, and carries the flexible-rule operands when the list uses them.
    - crmBasedUserList object - Source app for a CRM-based list. Present for CRM_BASED lists only.
    - logicalUserList object - Combination rules. Present for LOGICAL lists only.
    - lookalikeUserList object - Seed lists, country codes, and expansion level. Present for LOOKALIKE lists only.
    - extras object - This product's own record of the list, merged in when one exists locally. Absent for lists this service did not create.

Errors: 400, 401, 422, 500 (400, 401, 422, 500: see Common error responses)

POST /ad-publishing/linkedin/{accountId}/form
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/ad-publishing/linkedin/{accountId}/form
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/ad-publishing/li-create-lead-form | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/ad-publishing/li-create-lead-form.md

DEPRECATED. Scheduled for removal in a future version.

Create a new LinkedIn lead gen form for an ad account. Deprecated: use POST /ad-publishing/linkedin/accounts/{accountId}/form with header version: v4.

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: adPublishing.write

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Path parameters:
- accountId* string (e.g. "12345678") - Account identifier

Query parameters:
- locationId* string (e.g. "HChooFuiyPpVYzeJ4HMe") - Location identifier

Request body (required) (application/json) LinkedInCreateLeadFormBodyDTO:
- owner* object - Form owner
  - sponsoredAccount* string (e.g. "urn:li:sponsoredAccount:123456") - Sponsored account URN
- creationLocale* object - Creation locale
  - country* string (e.g. "US") - Country code
  - language* string (e.g. "en") - Language code
- name* string (e.g. "Contact Us") - Form name
- state* string (enum: PUBLISHED; e.g. "PUBLISHED") - Form state
- content* object - Form content
  - questions* object[] - Form questions
    - question* object - Question text
      - localized* object - Locale-keyed string map
    - name* string (e.g. "firstName") - Question field name
    - questionDetails* object - Question type details
      - textQuestionDetails object - Text question details (empty object for text questions)
      - multipleChoiceQuestionDetails object - Multiple choice question details
        - options* object[] - Choice options
          - id* number (e.g. 1) - Option ID
          - text* object - Option text
            - localized* object - Locale-keyed string map
    - predefinedField string (e.g. "FIRST_NAME") - Predefined field identifier
  - description object - Form description
    - localized* object - Locale-keyed string map
  - headline* object - Form headline
    - localized* object - Locale-keyed string map
  - postSubmissionInfo* object - Post-submission info
    - message* object - Thank-you message
      - localized* object - Locale-keyed string map
    - callToAction* object - Post-submission call to action
      - callToActionTarget* object - Call to action target
        - landingPageUrl* string (e.g. "https://example.com/thank-you") - Landing page URL
      - callToActionLabel* string (enum: VISIT_COMPANY_WEBSITE | DOWNLOAD_NOW | TRY_NOW | VIEW_NOW | LEARN_MORE; e.g. "LEARN_MORE") - Call to action label
  - legalInfo* object - Legal information
    - consents* object[] - Consent entries
      - checkRequired* boolean - Whether consent checkbox is required
      - id* number (e.g. 1) - Consent identifier
      - consent* object - Consent text
        - localized* object - Locale-keyed string map
    - privacyPolicyUrl* string (e.g. "https://example.com/privacy") - Privacy policy URL
    - legalDisclaimer object - Legal disclaimer text
      - localized* object - Locale-keyed string map
- hiddenFields object[] - Hidden fields
  - name* string (e.g. "utm_source") - Field name
  - value* string (e.g. "linkedin") - Field value

Response 200 (The created lead form. Same shape as a list entry, minus `reviewInfo` until LinkedIn reviews it.) application/json:
- id number - Form id. Returned as a number.
- name string - Form name
- state string - Form lifecycle state
- versionId number - Version of the form definition
- created number - When the form was created, epoch milliseconds
- lastModified number - When the form was last modified, epoch milliseconds
- creationLocale object - Locale the form was authored in
  - country* string - Two-letter country code
  - language* string - Two-letter language code
- owner object - Account that owns the form
  - sponsoredAccount* string - Sponsored account URN that owns the form
- reviewInfo object - LinkedIn review outcome. Absent on a form that has just been created and not yet reviewed; present on reads.
  - reviewStatus* string (enum: AUTO_APPROVED | NEEDS_REVIEW | REJECTED | APPROVED) - Review outcome
  - rejectionReasons* string[] - Why the form was rejected. Empty array when it was not.
  - lastUpdated* number - When the review last changed, epoch milliseconds
- hiddenFields object[] - Hidden fields submitted alongside the lead. Empty array when none.
  - name* string - Field name
  - value* string - Field value submitted with the lead
- content object - Form definition
  - headline* object - Localised form headline
    - localized* map<string, string> - Text keyed by locale, e.g. `en_US`. Keys depend on the form locale.
  - description object - Localised form description
    - localized* map<string, string> - Text keyed by locale, e.g. `en_US`. Keys depend on the form locale.
  - questions* object[] - Form questions in display order
    - questionId* number - LinkedIn question id
    - question* object - Localised question text
      - localized* map<string, string> - Text keyed by locale, e.g. `en_US`. Keys depend on the form locale.
    - name* string - Machine name for the field
    - label* string - Label shown next to the field
    - responseRequired* boolean - Whether the member must answer
    - responseEditable* boolean - Whether the member can edit a prefilled answer
    - predefinedField string - LinkedIn profile field the answer is prefilled from, e.g. `EMAIL`, `JOB_TITLE`. Absent for custom questions.
    - questionDetails* object - Type-specific configuration
      - textQuestionDetails object - Present for free-text questions
        - maxResponseLength* number - Maximum characters accepted
      - multipleChoiceQuestionDetails object - Present for multiple-choice questions
        - options* object[] - Selectable options
          - id* number - Zero-based option index
          - label* string - Option label
          - text* object - Localised option text
            - localized* map<string, string> - Text keyed by locale, e.g. `en_US`. Keys depend on the form locale.
  - postSubmissionInfo* object - What happens after submission
    - message* object - Localised thank-you message
      - localized* map<string, string> - Text keyed by locale, e.g. `en_US`. Keys depend on the form locale.
    - callToAction* object - Follow-up action offered after submission
      - callToActionLabel* string - Button label
      - callToActionTarget* object - Button destination
        - landingPageUrl* string - Where the member is sent after submitting
  - legalInfo* object - Privacy policy and consent configuration
    - legalInfoId* number - LinkedIn legal info id
    - privacyPolicyUrl* string - Privacy policy URL shown on the form
    - consents* object[] - Custom consent checkboxes. Empty array when none.
      - id* number - Consent id within the form
      - label* string - Consent label
      - checkRequired* boolean - Whether the member must tick the box to submit
      - consent* object - Localised consent text
        - localized* map<string, string> - Text keyed by locale, e.g. `en_US`. Keys depend on the form locale.
    - legalDisclaimer object - Optional legal disclaimer text
      - localized* map<string, string> - Text keyed by locale, e.g. `en_US`. Keys depend on the form locale.

Errors: 400, 401, 422, 500 (400, 401, 422, 500: see Common error responses)

### Get ad analytics
GET /ad-publishing/linkedin/reporting
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/ad-publishing/linkedin/reporting
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/ad-publishing/li-get-ad-analytics | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/ad-publishing/li-get-ad-analytics.md

Retrieve LinkedIn Ads analytics data with configurable pivot and time grouping

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: adPublishing.readonly

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Query parameters:
- locationId* string (e.g. "loc_abc123") - Location ID
- pivot string (enum: ACCOUNT | CAMPAIGN | CAMPAIGN_GROUP | CREATIVE; default: ACCOUNT) - Analytics pivot type
- groupBy string (enum: day | month | year; default: day) - Time granularity for analytics
- startDate* string (e.g. "2024-01-01") - Start date in yyyy-mm-dd format
- endDate* string (e.g. "2024-01-31") - End date in yyyy-mm-dd format
- entityUrns string (e.g. "urn:li:sponsoredCampaign:123,urn:li:sponsoredCampaign:456") - Comma-separated list of entity URNs
- fields string[] (enum: clicks | oneClickLeads | costInLocalCurrency | impressions | costInUsd | ctr | cpc | cpm | cpl | externalWebsitePostClickConversions | conversionRate; e.g. ["impressions","clicks","costInUsd"]) - Reporting fields. Pass as comma-separated values on the wire (e.g. ?fields=impressions,clicks).

Response 200 (Metrics grouped by the requested pivot, plus totals. Only the requested `fields` appear.) application/json:
- grouped* object[] - One entry per pivot bucket
  - impressions number - Impressions
  - clicks number - Clicks
  - oneClickLeads number - Leads captured through a one-click lead form
  - externalWebsitePostClickConversions number - Conversions recorded on an external site after a click
  - ctr number (nullable) - Click-through rate as a percentage, e.g. 1.40 means 1.40%. Null when it cannot be computed.
  - cpc number (nullable) - Cost per click in the account currency. Null when it cannot be computed.
  - cpm number (nullable) - Cost per thousand impressions. Null when it cannot be computed.
  - cpl number (nullable) - Cost per lead. Null when it cannot be computed.
  - conversionRate number (nullable) - Conversion rate as a percentage. Null when it cannot be computed.
  - pivotValues* string[] - URNs of the entity this row is pivoted on — a sponsored account, campaign group or creative depending on the request. This is not the time bucket; that is carried by `dateStart`/`dateEnd`.
  - dateStart* string - First day covered by the row
  - dateEnd* string - Last day covered by the row
  - costInUsd string - Spend in USD. Returned as a **string** on grouped rows, unlike in `totals`, and at full source precision — e.g. `899.99999999999988713`. Parse as a decimal rather than a float.
  - costInLocalCurrency string - Spend in the account currency. Returned as a **string** on grouped rows, unlike in `totals`, and at full source precision. Parse as a decimal rather than a float.
- totals* object - Metrics summed across every bucket
  - impressions number - Impressions
  - clicks number - Clicks
  - oneClickLeads number - Leads captured through a one-click lead form
  - externalWebsitePostClickConversions number - Conversions recorded on an external site after a click
  - ctr number (nullable) - Click-through rate as a percentage, e.g. 1.40 means 1.40%. Null when it cannot be computed.
  - cpc number (nullable) - Cost per click in the account currency. Null when it cannot be computed.
  - cpm number (nullable) - Cost per thousand impressions. Null when it cannot be computed.
  - cpl number (nullable) - Cost per lead. Null when it cannot be computed.
  - conversionRate number (nullable) - Conversion rate as a percentage. Null when it cannot be computed.
  - costInUsd number - Total spend in USD. Returned as a **number** here, unlike on grouped rows.
  - costInLocalCurrency number - Total spend in the account currency. Returned as a **number** here, unlike on grouped rows.

Errors: 400, 401, 422, 500 (400, 401, 422, 500: see Common error responses)
