### Get lead forms
GET /ad-publishing/linkedin/{accountId}/forms
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/ad-publishing/linkedin/{accountId}/forms
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/ad-publishing/li-get-lead-forms | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/ad-publishing/li-get-lead-forms.md

DEPRECATED. Scheduled for removal in a future version.

Retrieve LinkedIn lead gen forms for an ad account. By default each form is returned in full as a plain array; pass `projection` (comma-separated, dot-notation for nested fields) to return only the requested fields — any value outside the known field set is rejected. When `limit` is provided (max 100) the response is a paginated `{ leadForms, paging }` envelope; pass `pageToken` (from `paging.next`) to fetch the next batch. Deprecated: use GET /ad-publishing/linkedin/accounts/{accountId}/forms with header version: v4.

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: adPublishing.readonly

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Path parameters:
- accountId* string (e.g. "12345678") - Account identifier

Query parameters:
- locationId* string (e.g. "loc_abc123") - Location identifier
- projection string[] (enum: id | name | state | created | lastModified | versionId | creationLocale | owner | reviewInfo | reviewInfo.reviewStatus | reviewInfo.rejectionReasons | content | content.headline | content.questions | content.legalInfo | hiddenFields; e.g. ["id","name","state","created","reviewInfo.reviewStatus"]) - Fields to return on each lead form, comma-separated (e.g. ?projection=id,name,state,created,reviewInfo.reviewStatus). When set, only the requested fields are returned; any value outside the known field set is rejected. Nested fields use dot-notation (naming a parent like `reviewInfo` returns the whole object). Omit to receive the full form (including content.questions) as-is.
- limit string (e.g. "100") - Page size for a paginated fetch (max 100). When set, the response is a { leadForms, paging } envelope instead of a plain array.
- pageToken string (e.g. "100") - Opaque cursor for the next batch, taken from the previous response paging.next

Response 200 (A plain array of lead forms (default), or a { leadForms, paging } envelope when `limit` is provided) application/json:
- (root) object[] | object
  - option 1: object[]
    - id number - Form id. Returned as a number.
    - name string - Form name
    - state string - Form lifecycle state
    - versionId number - Version of the form definition
    - created number - When the form was created, epoch milliseconds
    - lastModified number - When the form was last modified, epoch milliseconds
    - creationLocale object - Locale the form was authored in
      - country* string - Two-letter country code
      - language* string - Two-letter language code
    - owner object - Account that owns the form
      - sponsoredAccount* string - Sponsored account URN that owns the form
    - reviewInfo object - LinkedIn review outcome. Absent on a form that has just been created and not yet reviewed; present on reads.
      - reviewStatus* string (enum: AUTO_APPROVED | NEEDS_REVIEW | REJECTED | APPROVED) - Review outcome
      - rejectionReasons* string[] - Why the form was rejected. Empty array when it was not.
      - lastUpdated* number - When the review last changed, epoch milliseconds
    - hiddenFields object[] - Hidden fields submitted alongside the lead. Empty array when none.
      - name* string - Field name
      - value* string - Field value submitted with the lead
    - content object - Form definition
      - headline* object - Localised form headline
        - localized* map<string, string> - Text keyed by locale, e.g. `en_US`. Keys depend on the form locale.
      - description object - Localised form description
        - localized* map<string, string> - Text keyed by locale, e.g. `en_US`. Keys depend on the form locale.
      - questions* object[] - Form questions in display order
        - questionId* number - LinkedIn question id
        - question* object - Localised question text
          - localized* map<string, string> - Text keyed by locale, e.g. `en_US`. Keys depend on the form locale.
        - name* string - Machine name for the field
        - label* string - Label shown next to the field
        - responseRequired* boolean - Whether the member must answer
        - responseEditable* boolean - Whether the member can edit a prefilled answer
        - predefinedField string - LinkedIn profile field the answer is prefilled from, e.g. `EMAIL`, `JOB_TITLE`. Absent for custom questions.
        - questionDetails* object - Type-specific configuration
          - textQuestionDetails object - Present for free-text questions
            - maxResponseLength* number - Maximum characters accepted
          - multipleChoiceQuestionDetails object - Present for multiple-choice questions
            - options* object[] - Selectable options
              - id* number - Zero-based option index
              - label* string - Option label
              - text* object - Localised option text
                - localized* map<string, string> - Text keyed by locale, e.g. `en_US`. Keys depend on the form locale.
      - postSubmissionInfo* object - What happens after submission
        - message* object - Localised thank-you message
          - localized* map<string, string> - Text keyed by locale, e.g. `en_US`. Keys depend on the form locale.
        - callToAction* object - Follow-up action offered after submission
          - callToActionLabel* string - Button label
          - callToActionTarget* object - Button destination
            - landingPageUrl* string - Where the member is sent after submitting
      - legalInfo* object - Privacy policy and consent configuration
        - legalInfoId* number - LinkedIn legal info id
        - privacyPolicyUrl* string - Privacy policy URL shown on the form
        - consents* object[] - Custom consent checkboxes. Empty array when none.
          - id* number - Consent id within the form
          - label* string - Consent label
          - checkRequired* boolean - Whether the member must tick the box to submit
          - consent* object - Localised consent text
            - localized* map<string, string> - Text keyed by locale, e.g. `en_US`. Keys depend on the form locale.
        - legalDisclaimer object - Optional legal disclaimer text
          - localized* map<string, string> - Text keyed by locale, e.g. `en_US`. Keys depend on the form locale.
  - option 2 PaginatedLinkedInLeadFormsDTO: object
    - leadForms* object[] - Page of LinkedIn lead gen forms
      - id number - Form id. Returned as a number.
      - name string - Form name
      - state string - Form lifecycle state
      - versionId number - Version of the form definition
      - created number - When the form was created, epoch milliseconds
      - lastModified number - When the form was last modified, epoch milliseconds
      - creationLocale object - Locale the form was authored in
        - country* string - Two-letter country code
        - language* string - Two-letter language code
      - owner object - Account that owns the form
        - sponsoredAccount* string - Sponsored account URN that owns the form
      - reviewInfo object - LinkedIn review outcome. Absent on a form that has just been created and not yet reviewed; present on reads.
        - reviewStatus* string (enum: AUTO_APPROVED | NEEDS_REVIEW | REJECTED | APPROVED) - Review outcome
        - rejectionReasons* string[] - Why the form was rejected. Empty array when it was not.
        - lastUpdated* number - When the review last changed, epoch milliseconds
      - hiddenFields object[] - Hidden fields submitted alongside the lead. Empty array when none.
        - name* string - Field name
        - value* string - Field value submitted with the lead
      - content object - Form definition
        - headline* object - Localised form headline
          - localized* map<string, string> - Text keyed by locale, e.g. `en_US`. Keys depend on the form locale.
        - description object - Localised form description
          - localized* map<string, string> - Text keyed by locale, e.g. `en_US`. Keys depend on the form locale.
        - questions* object[] - Form questions in display order
          - questionId* number - LinkedIn question id
          - question* object - Localised question text
            - localized* map<string, string> - Text keyed by locale, e.g. `en_US`. Keys depend on the form locale.
          - name* string - Machine name for the field
          - label* string - Label shown next to the field
          - responseRequired* boolean - Whether the member must answer
          - responseEditable* boolean - Whether the member can edit a prefilled answer
          - predefinedField string - LinkedIn profile field the answer is prefilled from, e.g. `EMAIL`, `JOB_TITLE`. Absent for custom questions.
          - questionDetails* object - Type-specific configuration
            - textQuestionDetails object - Present for free-text questions
              - maxResponseLength* number - Maximum characters accepted
            - multipleChoiceQuestionDetails object - Present for multiple-choice questions
              - options* object[] - Selectable options
                - id* number - Zero-based option index
                - label* string - Option label
                - text* object - Localised option text
                  - localized* map<string, string> - Text keyed by locale, e.g. `en_US`. Keys depend on the form locale.
        - postSubmissionInfo* object - What happens after submission
          - message* object - Localised thank-you message
            - localized* map<string, string> - Text keyed by locale, e.g. `en_US`. Keys depend on the form locale.
          - callToAction* object - Follow-up action offered after submission
            - callToActionLabel* string - Button label
            - callToActionTarget* object - Button destination
              - landingPageUrl* string - Where the member is sent after submitting
        - legalInfo* object - Privacy policy and consent configuration
          - legalInfoId* number - LinkedIn legal info id
          - privacyPolicyUrl* string - Privacy policy URL shown on the form
          - consents* object[] - Custom consent checkboxes. Empty array when none.
            - id* number - Consent id within the form
            - label* string - Consent label
            - checkRequired* boolean - Whether the member must tick the box to submit
            - consent* object - Localised consent text
              - localized* map<string, string> - Text keyed by locale, e.g. `en_US`. Keys depend on the form locale.
          - legalDisclaimer object - Optional legal disclaimer text
            - localized* map<string, string> - Text keyed by locale, e.g. `en_US`. Keys depend on the form locale.
    - paging* object - Pagination cursor
      - next* string (nullable) - Cursor for the next page of results, or null when there are no more pages

Errors: 400, 401, 422, 500 (400, 401, 422, 500: see Common error responses)

### Get reporting list
GET /ad-publishing/linkedin/reporting/list
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/ad-publishing/linkedin/reporting/list
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/ad-publishing/li-get-reporting-list | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/ad-publishing/li-get-reporting-list.md

DEPRECATED. Scheduled for removal in a future version.

Retrieve a list of LinkedIn campaigns or campaign groups with reporting data. Deprecated: use GET /ad-publishing/linkedin/reporting/rows with header version: v4.

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: adPublishing.readonly

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Query parameters:
- locationId* string (e.g. "loc_abc123") - Location ID
- listType* string (enum: campaignGroups | campaigns | ads; e.g. "campaigns") - List type
- campaignId* string (e.g. "12345678") - Campaign ID
- campaignGroupId* string (e.g. "87654321") - Campaign group ID
- startDate* string (e.g. "2024-01-01") - Start date in yyyy-mm-dd format
- endDate* string (e.g. "2024-01-31") - End date in yyyy-mm-dd format
- fields string[] (enum: clicks | oneClickLeads | costInLocalCurrency | impressions | costInUsd | ctr | cpc | cpm | cpl | externalWebsitePostClickConversions | conversionRate; e.g. ["impressions","clicks"]) - Reporting fields. Pass as comma-separated values on the wire (e.g. ?fields=impressions,clicks).

Response 200 (Metrics per entity for the period. Identity fields vary with `listType`.) application/json:
- (root) object[]
  - impressions number - Impressions
  - clicks number - Clicks
  - oneClickLeads number - Leads captured through a one-click lead form
  - externalWebsitePostClickConversions number - Conversions recorded on an external site after a click
  - ctr number (nullable) - Click-through rate as a percentage, e.g. 1.40 means 1.40%. Null when it cannot be computed.
  - cpc number (nullable) - Cost per click in the account currency. Null when it cannot be computed.
  - cpm number (nullable) - Cost per thousand impressions. Null when it cannot be computed.
  - cpl number (nullable) - Cost per lead. Null when it cannot be computed.
  - conversionRate number (nullable) - Conversion rate as a percentage. Null when it cannot be computed.
  - pivotValues* string[] - URNs of the entity this row is pivoted on — a sponsored account, campaign group or creative depending on the request. This is not the time bucket; that is carried by `dateStart`/`dateEnd`.
  - dateStart* string - First day covered by the row
  - dateEnd* string - Last day covered by the row
  - costInUsd string - Spend in USD. Returned as a **string** on grouped rows, unlike in `totals`, and at full source precision — e.g. `899.99999999999988713`. Parse as a decimal rather than a float.
  - costInLocalCurrency string - Spend in the account currency. Returned as a **string** on grouped rows, unlike in `totals`, and at full source precision. Parse as a decimal rather than a float.
  - _id* string - Stored record id, as `_id` rather than `id`
  - name* string - Entity name
  - publishingStatus* string - Publishing status
  - adCampaignGroupId string - LinkedIn campaign group id. Present when `listType` is `campaignGroups`.
  - adCampaignId string - Parent ad campaign record id. Present when `listType` is `ads`.
  - adId string - LinkedIn creative id. Present when `listType` is `ads`.
  - campaignName string - Name of the parent campaign. Present when `listType` is `ads`.

Errors: 400, 401, 422, 500 (400, 401, 422, 500: see Common error responses)

### Upsert ad campaign group
PUT /ad-publishing/linkedin/ads
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/ad-publishing/linkedin/ads
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/ad-publishing/li-upsert-campaign-group | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/ad-publishing/li-upsert-campaign-group.md

Create or update a LinkedIn ad campaign group with campaigns and ads

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: adPublishing.write

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Request body (required) (application/json) AdCampaignGroupDataDTO:
- id string (e.g. "cg_abc123") - Internal ID
- locationId* string (e.g. "loc_abc123") - Location ID
- budget object - Campaign group budget
  - budgetType* string (enum: DAILY | LIFETIME; e.g. "DAILY") - Budget cadence
  - amount* number (e.g. 30) - Budget amount in the account currency
  - scheduleStartDate string (e.g. "2026-08-18T07:40:10.110Z") - Schedule start
  - scheduleEndDate string (e.g. "2026-09-17T07:40:10.110Z") - Schedule end
- adCampaigns object[] - Child ad campaigns
  - id string (e.g. "camp_abc123") - Internal campaign identifier
  - locale object - Campaign locale
    - country* string (e.g. "US") - Country code
    - language* string (e.g. "en") - Language code
  - name string (e.g. "Q1 Lead Gen Campaign") - Campaign name
  - publishingStatus string (enum: DRAFT | SCHEDULED | PUBLISHED | PUBLISHING | FAILED | IN_REVIEW | PAUSED | ARCHIVED | WITH_ISSUES | REJECTED; e.g. "PUBLISHED") - Publishing status
  - mediaType string (enum: STANDARD_UPDATE | SINGLE_VIDEO | CAROUSEL; e.g. "STANDARD_UPDATE") - Creative media type for the campaign
  - audience object - Campaign audience targeting
    - geoLocations object[] - Geographic location targets
      - name* string (e.g. "India") - Location display name
      - urn* string (e.g. "urn:li:geo:12321321") - Location URN
      - facetUrn* string (e.g. "urn:li:adTargetingFacet:locations") - Facet URN
      - selectionType* string (enum: include | exclude; e.g. "include") - Selection type
    - targetAudience object - Target audience attribute selections
      - include object[][] - Included targeting attributes (groups of ANDed attributes, ORed together)
        - urn* string (e.g. "urn:li:geo:103644278") - Targeting attribute URN
        - name* string (e.g. "United States") - Display name
        - categoryName* string (e.g. "Location") - Category name
        - facet* string (e.g. "urn:li:adTargetingFacet:locations") - Facet identifier
      - exclude object[][] - Excluded targeting attributes. Same nested-array shape as `include` — outer entries are AND-ed, inner entries are OR-ed. Omit or send an empty array when nothing is excluded.
        - urn* string (e.g. "urn:li:geo:103644278") - Targeting attribute URN
        - name* string (e.g. "United States") - Display name
        - categoryName* string (e.g. "Location") - Category name
        - facet* string (e.g. "urn:li:adTargetingFacet:locations") - Facet identifier
  - unitCost object - Bid unit cost
    - amount* number (e.g. 5) - Bid amount (major currency units)
  - campaignType string (e.g. "SPONSORED_UPDATES") - LinkedIn campaign type
  - adCampaignGroupId string (e.g. "cg_abc123") - Parent campaign group identifier
  - adCampaignId string (e.g. "123456789") - LinkedIn campaign resource ID
  - ads object[] - Ads in the campaign
    - id* string (e.g. "6a840c7b1c2e6acf77b1d2a8") - Ad identifier
    - name* string (e.g. "Ad 1") - Ad name
    - adCampaignId* string (e.g. "6a840c7b1c2e6acf77b1d2a5") - Parent ad campaign id
    - adCampaignGroupId* string (e.g. "6a840c5a1c2e6acf77b1d258") - Parent campaign group id
    - adId string (e.g. "1554451156") - LinkedIn ad id, set once published
    - publishingStatus* string (e.g. "FAILED") - Publishing status
    - linkedInError* string (e.g. "") - Rejection or publish error from LinkedIn. Empty string when there is none.
    - introductoryText* string (e.g. "Grow your pipeline this quarter") - Body copy above the creative
    - description* string (e.g. "") - Ad description
    - destinationUrl* string (e.g. "https://example.com") - Click destination
    - destinationFormId* string (e.g. "") - Lead form id when the ad routes to a form instead of a URL
    - callToActionLabel* string (e.g. "APPLY") - Call-to-action button label
    - contentReferenceString string (e.g. "urn:li:share:7495384246371512320") - URN of the underlying LinkedIn share, set once published
    - media* object[] - Creative media
      - type* string (e.g. "image") - Media kind
      - src* string (e.g. "https://staging.files.leadconnectorhq.com/file/abc/def.png") - Source URL of the uploaded file
      - name* string (e.g. "creative.png") - Original file name
      - headline string (e.g. "Try it free") - Headline shown with this media
      - destinationUrl string (e.g. "example.com") - Click destination for this media
      - fileSizeBytes number (e.g. 1066210) - File size in bytes
      - urn string (e.g. "urn:li:image:D5610AQEjSUtmzK0rjw") - LinkedIn media URN, set once the asset has been uploaded. Observed present on reads but absent from the upsert response, which also returns a new `_id` for the same media — the subdocument appears to be replaced on save.
      - _id string (e.g. "6a840c881c2e6acf77b1d3c9") - Mongo subdocument id. Note `_id`, not `id` — the transform applies to the top-level document only.
    - createdAt* string (e.g. "2026-08-18T07:40:43.385Z") - Created at
    - updatedAt* string (e.g. "2026-08-18T07:45:04.624Z") - Updated at
  - linkedInError string (e.g. "Bid below minimum") - LinkedIn API error message
  - meta object - Additional campaign metadata
- adBudgetOptimization string (enum: MAXIMUM_DELIVERY | COST_CAP; e.g. "MAXIMUM_DELIVERY") - Ad budget optimization mode
- objectiveType string (enum: LEAD_GENERATION | WEBSITE_VISIT; e.g. "LEAD_GENERATION") - Campaign group objective
- name string (e.g. "Q1 Lead Gen") - Campaign group name
- adCampaignGroupId string (e.g. "123456789") - LinkedIn campaign group resource ID
- publishingStatus string (enum: DRAFT | SCHEDULED | PUBLISHED | PUBLISHING | FAILED | IN_REVIEW | PAUSED | ARCHIVED | WITH_ISSUES | REJECTED; e.g. "PUBLISHED") - Publishing status
- linkedInAdAccountId string (e.g. "12345678") - LinkedIn ad account identifier
- unpublishedChanges boolean - Whether the campaign group has unpublished changes
- meta object - Additional metadata
- linkedInError string (e.g. "Budget below minimum") - LinkedIn API error message
- customValueMappings object - User-provided overrides for custom_values merge tags used in ad copy

Response 200 (The saved campaign group, same shape as GET /linkedin/ads/{adId}) application/json:
- id* string - Campaign group identifier
- name* string - Campaign group name
- locationId* string - Location identifier
- linkedInAdAccountId* string - LinkedIn ad account id the group belongs to
- adCampaignGroupId string - LinkedIn campaign group id, set once published
- publishingStatus* string - Publishing status
- linkedInError* string - Publish or review error from LinkedIn. Empty string when there is none.
- objectiveType* string (enum: LEAD_GENERATION | WEBSITE_VISIT) - Campaign objective
- adBudgetOptimization string (enum: MAXIMUM_DELIVERY | COST_CAP) - Budget optimisation mode
- budget* object - Budget configuration
  - budgetType* string (enum: DAILY | LIFETIME) - Budget cadence
  - amount* number - Budget amount in the account currency
  - scheduleStartDate string - Schedule start
  - scheduleEndDate string - Schedule end
- adCampaigns* object[] - Ad campaigns with their ads
  - id* string - Ad campaign identifier
  - name* string - Ad campaign name
  - adCampaignGroupId* string - Parent campaign group id
  - adCampaignId string - LinkedIn campaign id, set once published
  - publishingStatus* string - Publishing status
  - linkedInError* string - Publish error from LinkedIn. Empty string when there is none.
  - campaignType* string (enum: SPONSORED_UPDATES) - Campaign type
  - mediaType* string (enum: STANDARD_UPDATE | CAROUSEL | SINGLE_VIDEO) - Creative format
  - locale* object - Campaign locale
    - country* string - Two-letter country code
    - language* string - Two-letter language code
  - unitCost object - Bid configuration
    - amount* number - Bid amount in the account currency
  - audience* object - Targeting
    - geoLocations* object[] - Geographic targeting
      - name* string - Display name
      - urn* string - Entity URN. The scheme depends on the facet being searched.
      - facetUrn* string - Facet the entity belongs to
      - selectionType* string (enum: include | exclude) - Whether the location is targeted or excluded
    - targetAudience object - Attribute targeting, as nested include/exclude arrays
  - ads* object[] - Ads in this campaign
    - id* string - Ad identifier
    - name* string - Ad name
    - adCampaignId* string - Parent ad campaign id
    - adCampaignGroupId* string - Parent campaign group id
    - adId string - LinkedIn ad id, set once published
    - publishingStatus* string - Publishing status
    - linkedInError* string - Rejection or publish error from LinkedIn. Empty string when there is none.
    - introductoryText* string - Body copy above the creative
    - description* string - Ad description
    - destinationUrl* string - Click destination
    - destinationFormId* string - Lead form id when the ad routes to a form instead of a URL
    - callToActionLabel* string - Call-to-action button label
    - contentReferenceString string - URN of the underlying LinkedIn share, set once published
    - media* object[] - Creative media
      - type* string - Media kind
      - src* string - Source URL of the uploaded file
      - name* string - Original file name
      - headline string - Headline shown with this media
      - destinationUrl string - Click destination for this media
      - fileSizeBytes number - File size in bytes
      - urn string - LinkedIn media URN, set once the asset has been uploaded. Observed present on reads but absent from the upsert response, which also returns a new `_id` for the same media — the subdocument appears to be replaced on save.
      - _id string - Mongo subdocument id. Note `_id`, not `id` — the transform applies to the top-level document only.
    - createdAt* string - Created at
    - updatedAt* string - Updated at
  - createdAt* string - Created at
  - updatedAt* string - Updated at
- meta object - Ancillary metadata
  - evaluate string - Opportunity-score result, stored as a JSON **string** rather than an object — parse before use. Present only after the campaign group has been evaluated.
- unpublishedChanges boolean - Whether the group has edits not yet published. Absent on reads that have never been edited; set by the upsert.
- createdBy* string - User who created the group
- updatedBy* string - User who last updated the group
- createdAt* string - Created at
- updatedAt* string - Updated at

Errors: 400, 401, 422, 500 (400, 401, 422, 500: see Common error responses)
